description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Virtual Executive Assistant em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Blue Dot, headquartered in São Paulo, is a leading company in the Contact Center and Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) segment, with over 10 years of international experience. Specialized in Staffing solutions for companies in the United States, we connect highly qualified talent in Brazil with global career opportunities.

Our operation is strategically located in one of the largest metropolitan areas in the world, allowing us to access a broad, diverse, and highly skilled workforce.

Value Package for the Professional

  • Compensation: R$ 3,500.00
  • Structured career plan: real opportunities for growth into leadership positions
  • Professional stability: permanent position with a long-term focus
  • Continuous development: regular technical and behavioral training
  • Multicultural and dynamic environment with international exposure

Mandatory Requirements

  • Fluent English (C1 or C2 level, both spoken and written) – will be assessed during the process
  • Clear, professional, and objective communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills, productivity focus, and multitasking ability
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, project management tools, or automation tools

General Job Information

  • Schedule: Monday to Friday, from 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM (Brasília time)

  • Work model: 100% remote

Key Responsibilities

You will act as a strategic remote support professional for our clients in the United States, focusing on operational efficiency, service excellence, and commercial support. Responsibilities include:

Executive and Administrative Support

  • Managing calendars, meetings, and appointments
  • Handling corporate emails and preparing executive reports
  • Supporting administrative routines

International Recruitment

  • Sourcing and screening candidates for U.S.-based roles
  • Conducting cold calls, interviews, and follow-ups

Commercial Support

Project Management (PMO)

  • Assisting with timelines, meetings, and task delegation

  • Supporting social media, content creation, and data entry

Accounts Receivable (Finance)

  • Issuing and sending invoices
  • Monitoring payments and tracking outstanding balances
  • Assisting in preparing financial reports

Desired Profile

  • Analytical, resilient, and strategic mindset
  • Ability to adapt to different demands and industries
  • Interest in building a long-term international career

How to Apply

Submit your application and become part of a team committed to excellence, connecting professionals with leading companies in the international market.

If you are selected to move forward in the process, we will contact you via LinkedIn.

title: Consultor(A) Funcional Salesforce - Pleno
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor(A) Funcional Salesforce - Pleno em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Consultor(a) Funcional Salesforce (Sales & Service Cloud)A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que unetecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitaispara solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora comoparte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas comoSmiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgásconfiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantirambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura demulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?Qual será o seu papel? Como consultor Funcional, você atuará comoKey User funcionalespecializado em Salesforce Sales Cloud e Service Cloud, sendo a ponte entre o time comercial (vendas e atendimento) e as áreas técnicas de TI. Seu principal objetivo é garantir a correta utilização da plataforma, aumentar a produtividade dos usuários, traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos funcionais e apoiar a evolução contínua dos processos de CRM, sempre com foco na experiência do cliente e na eficiência operacional.Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar usuários comerciais no uso diário do Salesforce, tirando dúvidas, resolvendo problemas de navegação e promovendo boas práticas. Executar atividades operacionais relacionadas a processos de vendas (ex.: criação e acompanhamento de oportunidades, leads, contratos) e atendimento (casos, resolução de solicitações). Detalhar requisitos de negócio junto aos times de vendas, marketing e serviços, transformando demandas em especificações funcionais claras para o time técnico. Validar soluções funcionais antes da liberação em produção, realizando testes de aceitação (UAT) em Sales Cloud e Service Cloud. Homologar novas funcionalidades, fluxos e relatórios, garantindo que atendam aos critérios de negócio e qualidade. Identificar gargalos e melhorias nos processos comerciais e de relacionamento com clientes, propondo ajustes na configuração ou no uso do sistema. Participar de rituais ágeis (daily, review, planning) com o time de CRM, trazendo a visão do negócio. Criar e manter documentação de suporte, manuais e treinamentos para usuários finais.Para esta vaga, é essencial: Experiência prática comprovada emSalesforce Sales CloudeService Cloud(mínimo 2 anos atuando como key user, analista funcional ou consultor). Conhecimento sólido deprocessos de vendas,CRMeatendimento ao cliente(ex.: ciclo de leads, oportunidades, casos, SLAs). Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos funcionais claros e testáveis. Boa comunicação verbal e escrita para interagir com usuários negócio e times técnicos. Visão de processo e pensamento analítico para identificar melhorias e resolver problemas. Perfil colaborativo, paciente e didático para treinar e apoiar usuários com diferentes níveis de maturidade digital.Você pode se destacar se: Possuir certificações Salesforce, como Salesforce Certified Administrator ou Sales Cloud Consultant / Service Cloud Consultant. Tiver experiência com configurações básicas na plataforma (criação de campos, objetos, perfis, fluxos de aprovação, relatórios e dashboards). Demonstrar conhecimento em ferramentas de automação (Flow, Process Builder) ou integrações (API, middleware). Já tiver atuado em projetos de implantação ou migração de CRM. Apresentar familiaridade com métricas comerciais (funnel de vendas, tempo médio de resposta, NPS, etc.) e capacidade de criar KPIs no Salesforce. Ter experiência em setores regulados (financeiro, utilities, telecom) que exigem governança e rastreabilidade. Mostrar proatividade na gestão de mudanças e no treinamento de novos usuários (produção de materiais e workshops).Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente!

title: Vexos Platform Manager (Remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Vexos Platform Manager (Remote) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're Hiring | VEXOS Platform Manager

Remote · Full-Time | Based in Brazil

The Render Pros is the presales creative engine behind some of the most ambitious real estate developments in the world. We build photorealistic visualizations, immersive digital experiences, and VEXOS — our proprietary presales platform that transforms how developers market and sell high-value assets before they're built.

We're growing and we need a sharp, reliable operator to help us run VEXOS smoothly.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

About The Render Pros / VEXOS

We are a vertically integrated presales studio. Our clients are real estate developers, luxury asset companies, and investment groups working on projects across the Western hemisphere. VEXOS is our platform product — a fully branded, data-driven presales environment that combines 3D visualization, buyer engagement tools, and lead intelligence. We define the strategy. You help us execute it.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The Role

The VEXOS Platform Manager supports the delivery and day-to-day management of VEXOS client deployments. You will work closely with our Visualization PMs, development team, and founder to keep projects on track and clients well-supported.

You are organized, communicative, and detail-oriented. You follow process, flag issues early, and represent the platform professionally to clients. You execute the vision — you don't set it.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

What You'll Be Responsible For

- Coordinating VEXOS project timelines alongside the Visualization PM

- Scheduling and running client onboarding and training calls using provided materials

- Managing client communication after delivery — answering questions, logging change requests, and escalating issues to the right internal person

- Keeping project trackers, onboarding checklists, and documentation up to date

- Following established delivery SOPs and flagging when something is off-track

- Supporting the creation of training materials, guides, and client-facing documentation as directed

- Being the day-to-day client contact for active VEXOS accounts

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

What We're Looking For

Experience

- 2–4 years in a client-facing coordination, account support, or digital project management role

- Experience working with SaaS platforms, creative tech, or digital products is a plus

- Background in real estate or luxury industries is a bonus, not a requirement

Skills

- Exceptional written and spoken English — you will be communicating with US-based executive clients daily

- Comfortable learning and navigating new software platforms quickly

- Able to explain digital tools clearly to non-technical users

- Highly organized with strong attention to detail

- Responsive, professional, and calm under pressure

- Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift

Mindset

- You follow through. Every time.

- You communicate proactively — you don't go quiet when things get complicated

- You take pride in representing a premium brand to premium clients

- You're here to execute at a high level and grow with the company

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Tools You'll Work With

VEXOS platform (proprietary) · Notion or Asana · Zoom · Google Workspace · Loom

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

What We Offer

- Competitive salary in USD

- 100% remote — work from Brazil or Mexico

- Direct day-to-day collaboration with the founder

- A stable, long-term role in a growing company

- Opportunity to grow into greater responsibility as VEXOS scales

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

How to Apply

Send your CV and a short Loom video (2–3 minutes) covering:

1. Who you are and what you've managed

2. Why this role interests you

3. One example of how you handled a difficult client situation

Applications without the Loom video will not be reviewed.

Apply via DM or email:

#hiring #remotejobs #vexos #therenderpos #proptech #projectmanager #clientsuccess #remotework #Brazil #Mexico #latinamerica

title: Creative Producer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Creative Producer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

VOA Creative Producer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM

About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across diverse genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creative Creative Producer to manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content.

Role Overview

As a Creative Producer, you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of audio content across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, voice artists, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and the ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders to deliver compelling audio experiences for our listeners.

Key Responsibilities

1. Content Operations Management

Ensure smooth daily operations of running audio shows and manage the production pipeline to deliver episodes as per planned schedules.

2. Creator & Talent Coordination

Work closely with voice-over artists, creators, writers, and dubbing artists (both internal and external) to produce engaging audio content.

3. Production Planning

Collaborate with content and production teams to plan episode pipelines, track weekly deliverables, and ensure timely completion of projects.

4. Stakeholder Collaboration

Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Marketing, Product, and Quality teams to ensure alignment on production goals and timelines.

5. Production Quality Oversight

Work closely with the QC team to maintain high production standards, ensuring the final content meets quality benchmarks before launch.

6. Creator Network Management

Build and manage a network of internal and external creators and production partners to support large-scale content creation.

7. Audience Feedback Monitoring

Track user feedback and listener comments to identify potential issues related to voice quality, narration, or sound production and coordinate with relevant teams for improvements.

8. Process & Workflow Optimization

Identify opportunities to improve production workflows, creator management processes, and operational efficiency across projects.

9. Volume & Deadline Management

Manage multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring deadlines are met and quality standards are maintained.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in content production, creator management, or media production.
  • Strong understanding of audio storytelling, podcast production, or audiobook production workflows.
  • Proven experience working with creators, voice artists, or creative production teams.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments and handle high-volume content production.
  • Self-motivated with strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset.

Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Medical Doctor (Physician), who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will:

  • Responsible for signal detection and evaluation activities for assigned products.
  • Ensures that accurate and fit-for-purpose evaluation documents with clear conclusions are provided in response to internal or regulatory authority requests for safety data.
  • Assists in the production of Risk Management Plans (RMPs)/Risk Tables for designated products, in consultation with senior personnel.

Mandatory Skills:

  • Medical Doctor
  • English fluently
  • Relevant experience in pharmacovigilance or drug development
  • Pharmacovigilance experience relating to Safety Evaluation and Risk Management, encompassing both clinical development and post-marketing activities
  • Knowledge/experience of international pharmacovigilance requirements (e.G., ICH, GVP modules, CIOMS initiatives) and drug development and approval processes.

title: Post Producer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Post Producer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Post Producer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM

About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across diverse genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creative Creative Producer to manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content.

Role Overview

As a Creative Producer, you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of audio content across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, voice artists, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and the ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders to deliver compelling audio experiences for our listeners.

Key Responsibilities

1. Post Production Operations Management

Oversee day-to-day post-production operations for ongoing audio shows and promotional adds, ensuring smooth workflows from raw audio to final delivery. Manage editing, sound design, mixing, and mastering pipelines to meet release schedules.

2. Post Production Team Coordination

Work closely with editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, and external post-production vendors to deliver high-quality audio content. Ensure clear briefs, efficient collaboration, and consistency across outputs.

3. Production Planning & Pipeline Management

Collaborate with content and production teams to plan post-production schedules, track weekly deliverables, and ensure timely completion of all episodes. Proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks in the pipeline.

4. Stakeholder Collaboration

Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Marketing, Product, and Quality Control to align on timelines, creative requirements, and delivery standards.

5. Audio Quality & Finishing Oversight

Own the final quality of all audio outputs, including editing precision, sound design, mixing balance, mastering levels, and overall listening experience. Ensure all content meets defined technical and creative benchmarks before release.

6. Vendor & Partner Management

Build and manage a network of external studios, freelancers, and post-production partners to support scalable content production. Ensure quality, consistency, and timely delivery across partners.

7. Feedback Integration & Continuous Improvement

Monitor listener feedback and internal QC inputs to identify issues related to audio clarity, pacing, sound design, or technical quality. Drive improvements across post-production processes.

8. Process & Workflow Optimization

Continuously enhance post-production workflows, tools, and standards to improve efficiency, scalability, and output quality. Document best practices, templates, and guidelines for consistent execution.

9. Volume & Deadline Management

Manage high-volume content pipelines across multiple shows, ensuring all deadlines are met without compromising on audio quality or production standards.

10. Quality Control Training & Creative Alignment

Continuously train and support QC team members responsible for assigned shows to ensure strong alignment on creative direction, audio quality standards, storytelling expectations, and technical benchmarks. Work closely with QC specialists on a weekly basis to review content, calibrate feedback, identify recurring issues, and maintain consistency across shows and post-production outputs.

11. Internal Promotional Video Post-Production Leadership

Lead the internal post-production team for promotional video assets, aligning editors, sound designers, and mixers around consistent quality standards, sonic identity, creative style, and delivery expectations. Ensure all promotional videos maintain a cohesive audio language, polished sound design, and production value aligned with brand and marketing objectives.

12. AI-driven Innovations and tool adotion

Leverage AI-powered tools and emerging technologies across editing, sound design, voice processing, mixing, mastering, QC, and workflow automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and creative quality. Stay updated on evolving AI trends in post-production and evaluate new tools/workflows that enhance turnaround time, consistency, audio quality, and overall production effectiveness while maintaining strong creative and editorial standards.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in post-production, audio production, or media production, with a strong focus on editing, sound design, and final delivery workflows.
  • Solid understanding of audio storytelling and hands-on experience across post-production stages, including editing, mixing, mastering, and finishing for podcasts or audiobooks.
  • Proven experience working with post-production teams such as editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, or external production vendors.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple post-production pipelines and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Effective stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across content, production, and quality teams.
  • Ability to operate in fast-paced, high-volume production environments while maintaining consistent quality standards.
  • Self-driven with strong problem-solving capabilities and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving production challenges.

title: Senior Golang Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Golang Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are hiring on behalf of our client, a global leader in the meal kit delivery industry that helps millions of customers cook healthy, homemade meals without the stress of meal planning or grocery shopping.

As part of Zoolatech's distributed engineering team, you will join the Market Innovation team - a fast-moving internal innovation group focused on building and delivering new product initiatives across multiple domains and services. Unlike traditional product teams, this team operates across different repositories, architectures, and backend ecosystems, taking ownership of complex discovery-driven projects from investigation to MVP delivery.

By joining Zoolatech, you will work closely with senior engineering leadership and global stakeholders in a highly autonomous environment that values ownership, adaptability, strong communication, and engineering curiosity.

Responsibilities

  • Investigate and understand existing backend services and distributed systems
  • Design and implement backend solutions primarily using Golang
  • Work on MVP delivery from technical discovery through implementation
  • Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders across multiple domains and teams
  • Communicate technical findings and proposed solutions clearly
  • Adapt quickly to new codebases, services, and technologies
  • Contribute to scalable and maintainable backend architecture

Skills Required

  • Strong commercial experience with Golang
  • Strong background in backend development, microservices, and distributed systems
  • Experience building event-driven architectures using messaging technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS SQS/SNS
  • Solid understanding of testing practices, including unit and end-to-end testing
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases
  • Ability to quickly understand and navigate unfamiliar codebases and services
  • Strong problem-solving and backend investigation skills
  • Good communication skills and ability to work independently
  • English level sufficient for direct communication with international teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Python
  • Familiarity with MongoDB, Elasticsearch, GraphQL, or JVM languages
  • Experience working in fast-paced MVP or startup-like environments

Engagement Model: Direct Independent Contractor (Please read carefully)

This is an independent contractor opportunity based on a direct contractual relationship between Zoolatech and the individual service provider.

To facilitate this direct partnership, we engage with professionals who are registered and operate as a sole proprietorship, private entrepreneur, or an equivalent self-employment status in your country.

Please note, our model does not accommodate contracts through third-party intermediaries such as agencies, incubators, or umbrella companies. The essential requirement is your ability to enter into a service agreement and invoice Zoolatech directly. This is not an offer of direct employment

Please note that only candidates whose profiles closely match our requirements will be contacted.

description:

Programa:

Como funciona?

  • Você participa de um processo seletivo e, se aprovado(a), se inscreve para estudar alemão por até 2 anos na maior escola online de alemão da América Latina, até atingir o nível B2 (final do intermediário). Antes de iniciar seus estudos, você recebe um contrato com garantia de emprego na Alemanha, com cláusulas específicas e seguras — desde que cumpra os requisitos do programa. Se a S&W não conseguir sua colocação após você atingir o B2, o valor investido é devolvido integralmente. Durante todo o período de estudo, você conta com mentoria direcionada da Sprache&Wissen.

Quem é a Sprache&Wissen?

  • A Sprache&Wissen (S&W) é uma empresa brasileira fundada por dois irmãos mineiros: um administrador formado pelo CEFET-MG e uma professora de alemão doutora pela UFMG. O grupo educacional administra as marcas Clube de Alemão, Punkify e Vale-idiomas. A S&W é a maior escola online de alemão da América Latina, com a meta de capacitar 100 mil brasileiros até 2030 nos idiomas alemão e inglês. Possui mais de 500 mil seguidores nas redes sociais e satisfação de 98,9%.

Principais atividades (na Alemanha):

  • Cuidado direto ao paciente em ambiente hospitalar ou clínico
  • Administração de medicamentos e acompanhamento de tratamentos
  • Documentação clínica e comunicação com equipe multidisciplinar em alemão
  • Participação em plantões conforme escala do empregador

Requisitos:

  • Diploma de Enfermagem (bacharelado) reconhecido no Brasil
  • Idade máxima de 36 anos (requisito do programa de visto alemão)
  • Disponibilidade para estudar alemão por até 2 anos até o nível B2, com flexibilidade de horários
  • Comprometimento com a carga horária do curso e as etapas do programa
  • Documentação em dia para solicitação de visto (passaporte válido ou possibilidade de emitir)

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento prévio de alemão (qualquer nível)
  • Experiência em UTI, emergência ou centro cirúrgico
  • Experiência internacional ou intercâmbio
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado

Sobre o período de estudos (home office):

  • O curso de alemão é 100% online — você estuda do Brasil enquanto se prepara
  • Mentoria gratuita em grupo durante toda a jornada até o B2
  • Flexibilidade para conciliar com seu emprego atual

Etapas do processo:

  • Inscrição e triagem inicial
  • Entrevista com o time da S&W
  • Aprovação de ficha e documentações
  • Assinatura do contrato com garantia de emprego
  • Matrícula no curso de alemão (até o nível B2)
  • Match com recrutador alemão
  • Colocação profissional na Alemanha

    able to identify retention risks and expansion opportunities during support interactions

hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doençasde acordo com o diagnóstico e faixa etária.Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas emPediatria.Garantir o respeito ao ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente) com respeito aos seus direitos e prerrogativas para o cuidado em saúde.Realizar consulta individualizada ao adolescente mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS E PREFERÊNCIAS DE HABILIDADESFormação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EMPEDIATRIACertificações: title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Project Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company

Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.

About the Role

The Technical Project Manager will work closely with engineering and collaborate with client experience, operations, and leadership to manage technical projects from planning through completion. This person should be organized, clear, and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is not a purely administrative project management role. The right person should understand enough about software, APIs, data, incident management, change management, and technical dependencies to ask good questions, spot blockers, and help teams stay aligned. Familiarity with ITIL practices is important, especially around incident management, change management, service management, problem management, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

  • Manage technical projects across engineering, product, and operations.
  • Help define project scope, timelines, milestones, owners, and priorities.
  • Track progress and make sure work is moving forward.
  • Identify blockers, risks, and dependencies early.
  • Keep stakeholders updated on status, changes, and next steps.
  • Coordinate technical work involving APIs, data, internal tools, customer workflows, IT systems, and integrations.
  • Help organize Jira tickets, documentation, meeting notes, and follow-ups.
  • Make sure decisions, requirements, and action items are clearly documented.
  • Support launch planning, testing coordination, and rollout communication.
  • Support incident follow-ups, change coordination, and post-implementation reviews.
  • Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution.
  • Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role.
  • Experience working with software engineering teams.
  • Familiarity with ITIL practices, including incident management, change management, problem management, service management, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong understanding of basic technical concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations, cloud systems, IT systems, and production releases.
  • Strong communication and organization skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities.
  • Able to turn unclear problems into clear next steps.
  • Experience using tools like Jira Software, Confluence, Slack, GitHub, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms.

Required Skills

  • ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in fintech, payments, fraud prevention, chargebacks, banking, or risk.
  • Experience working on customer integrations or partner integrations.
  • Basic SQL knowledge.
  • Experience working at a startup or small fast-moving company.
  • Familiarity with compliance, reporting, audits, service management, or operational workflows.

What Success Looks Like

  • Projects have clear owners, timelines, and next steps.
  • Engineering has fewer interruptions caused by unclear requirements or missing coordination.
  • Leadership has better visibility into what is being worked on, what is blocked, and what needs a decision.
  • Teams are aligned before launches, production changes, and major operational updates.
  • Incidents, changes, and follow-up actions are tracked clearly.
  • Work gets delivered more consistently without adding unnecessary process.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is organized, technical enough to understand engineering and IT discussions, and practical enough to keep things moving. They should be able to communicate clearly, follow up consistently, and help bring structure to fast-moving projects without slowing the team down.

title: Sr Ai Engineer - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr Ai Engineer - Brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior AI Engineer PITZ | Remote | Reports to CTOA trillion-dollar industry still runs on phone calls. We're building the intelligence that replaces it. PITZ is the infrastructure layer for the global automotive aftermarket. A mechanic speaks — in Spanish, Portuguese, or English, in a noisy shop — and our system diagnoses the failure, identifies the exact part, selects the supplier, underwrites credit, and executes the order. No screen. No typing. No human in the loop. We're live in Mexico and Brazil. Entering the US this year. And we need someone to build the brain behind all of it. Why this role existsWe're not hiring a cog for an AI team. There is no AI team yet. You'd be the first dedicated AI hire. You'll work directly with the CEO to design and build the entire intelligence layer — voice pipeline, recommendation engine, credit scoring, and the data flywheel that makes everything compound. If you deliver, you become Head of AI within 12 months. Not as a title bump — because you'll have built the thing from scratch and no one will know it better than you. This is a role for someone who's been a Senior ML Engineer or AI Lead somewhere and knows they're ready for more — but hasn't had the chance to prove it because there's always someone above them. Here, there's no one above you. Just the problem and the product.What you'll buildThe voice-to-action pipeline.Mechanic speech in noisy shops → intent extraction → diagnostic prediction → SKU mapping from millions of parts → order execution. Three languages. Regional slang. Background noise. Real world, not a lab. The recommendation engine.Right part, right seller, right price, right delivery. This is where margin lives. Every percentage point of improvement moves real revenue. The credit scoring models.Behavioral underwriting for mechanics with no credit history. Turn operational data — order frequency, payment patterns, voice engagement — into financial signals. The data flywheel.Every interaction makes the system smarter. You design the architecture that turns daily transactions into compounding intelligence. US market integrations.Connect PITZ to Identifix, ALLDATA, OBD platforms, PartsTech, Mitchell1. Adapt models for the US vehicle fleet and English-speaking mechanics.What you bring3-5 years building ML/AI systems in production.Not notebooks. Not demos. Systems that real users interact with daily and that break in interesting ways. NLP or voice experience.You've worked with speech recognition, intent extraction, text classification, or conversational AI. Bonus if it was in noisy, multilingual, or domain-specific environments. Full-stack ML instincts.You can train a model, build the data pipeline, optimize inference, deploy it, and monitor it. You don't wait for a platform team — you are the platform team. Builder mentality.You've worked in startups or fast-moving environments. You ship fast. You make decisions with 70% of the data. You'd rather build something imperfect today than plan something perfect for next quarter. Fluent English required. Spanish or Portuguese strongly preferred.You'll work with mechanics, ops teams, and partners across three countries.Requirements Timezone:Must be available during US/LatAm business hours (UTC-3 to UTC-8). This is a real-time collaboration role, not async. Commitment:This is a full-time, dedicated position. If you're currently juggling multiple roles — this isn't a fit. We need 100%. Travel:Periodic travel to Mexico City and São Paulo. You'll visit workshops, hear mechanics, and see the product in action. If you've never left your desk to watch a user interact with your model — this will change that.What makes this differentAt most companies, a Senior AI Engineer optimizes a model inside a product someone else designed. Here, you design the product. The intelligence layer IS the product. There's no PM handing you a spec. There's no VP of AI telling you the roadmap. You figure out what to build, you build it, and you see it run a real supply chain the next day. You'll work with proprietary data that doesn't exist anywhere else — millions of real mechanic-to-system interactions mapped to parts, orders, payments, and outcomes. Your models get better not because of more compute, but because of more reality. And if you prove you can own this — you lead the team we build around it.

Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution. Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead.Qualifications 5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role. Experience working with software engineering teams. Familiarity with ITIL practices, including incident management, change management, problem management, service management, and continuous improvement. Strong understanding of basic technical concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations, cloud systems, IT systems, and production releases. Strong communication and organization skills. Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time. Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities. Able to turn unclear problems into clear next steps. Experience using tools like Jira Software, Confluence, Slack, GitHub, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms.Required Skills ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience. Experience in fintech, payments, fraud prevention, chargebacks, banking, or risk. Experience working on customer integrations or partner integrations. Basic SQL knowledge. Experience working at a startup or small fast-moving company. title: Engenheiro De Ia Generativa - Especialista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro De Ia Generativa - Especialista em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista em IA Generativa, com forte domínio técnico e capacidade de influenciar decisões arquiteturais e estratégicas. Essa posição atua de forma transversal, apoiando a evolução da plataforma de LLMOps e a entrega de soluções de alto impacto para o negócio. Construção e evolução de soluções de IA Generativa que suportam jornadas críticas do banco, integrando modelos, dados e plataformas com alto padrão de engenharia. Foco está em escalar o uso de LLMs de forma segura, governada e sustentável, apoiando produtos, operações e áreas internas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Suas atividades:

- Desenvolver soluções de IA Generativa de ponta a ponta, desde a concepção técnica até a operação em produção.

- Liderar ou apoiar a criação de copilots, automações e assistentes para clientes e áreas internas, garantindo qualidade, segurança e escalabilidade.

- Evoluir a plataforma de LLMOps com foco em governança, rastreabilidade, observabilidade, custo e segurança.

- Atuar de forma integrada com times de arquitetura, engenharia, produto e operações na definição e implementação de soluções com impacto direto no negócio.

- Definir e disseminar boas práticas de CI/CD aplicadas a IA Generativa, em ambientes on-premise e cloud.

- Investigar falhas e incidentes em produção, conduzindo análise de causa raiz e propondo melhorias estruturais.

- Promover boas práticas técnicas, revisão de código, padronização de soluções e compartilhamento de conhecimento entre os times.

Perfil esperado:

- Comunicação clara e objetiva com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.

- Capacidade de tomada de decisão técnica ou forte influência como referência no time.

- Habilidade para traduzir demandas de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis e sustentáveis.

- Postura colaborativa, com senso de ownership e foco em entrega contínua.

- Vivência em ambientes ágeis, com visão de produto e melhoria incremental.

Requisitos e qualificações

- Experiência com IA Generativa, LLMs, embeddings e técnicas de NLP.

- Domínio de Python e de bibliotecas e frameworks como LangChain, Transformers ou equivalentes.

- Experiência avançada com arquiteturas de RAG, incluindo técnicas como re-ranking, chunking dinâmico e recuperação sensível a contexto.

- Conhecimento sólido em Git e bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.

- Vivência em Ciência de Dados aplicada a dados não estruturados.

- Experiência prática com LLMOps, incluindo pipelines, versionamento, monitoramento, avaliação e controle de custo de modelos.

Diferenciais:

- Experiência com modelos open-source como Mistral, LLaMA, Mixtral e Phi.

- Atuação com agentes autônomos ou orquestração de fluxos com LangGraph ou ferramentas similares.

- Conhecimento de protocolos e padrões emergentes como MCP e A2A.

title: Médico Pediatra
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico Pediatra em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO PEDIATRA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\ "

Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Pediatria! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.

*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:*

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*

Estamos em busca de Médico/a Pediatra, comprometidos e capacitados para se juntarem à nossa equipe multidisciplinar. Nosso time de médicos desempenham um papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, para sanar suas dúvidas, atender as demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é um profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você!

O médico será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, na modalidade especialidade em Pediatria, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;

PAPEL E RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Pediatria de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.
  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de crianças e adolescentes em suas múltiplas facetas e condições.
  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Pediatria e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.
  • Competência na avaliação pediátrica, incluindo o reconhecimento de problemas e doenças que possam estar presente nesta faixa etária.
  • Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais através de vídeochamada com o responsável.
  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.
  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de acordo com o diagnóstico e faixa etária.
  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.
  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.
  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde da criança e do adolescente.
  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Pediatria.
  • Garantir o respeito ao ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente) com respeito aos seus direitos e prerrogativas para o cuidado em saúde.
  • Realizar consulta individualizada ao adolescente sem necessidade de responsável a partir dos 12 anos de idade conforme previsto pelo ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente), caso solicitado ou quando avaliada necessária.
  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.
  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe crianças e adolescentes a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.
  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.
  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.
  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.
  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.
  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS E PREFERÊNCIAS DE HABILIDADES

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM PEDIATRIA

Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Pediatria - RQE emitido pelo Conselho respectivo;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).

Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Pediatria, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;

Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Médico competente em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de Crianças e Adolescentes.

Competências Comportamentais:

Médico comprometido com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.

Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

Local de Trabalho:

O Médico atuará remotamente, conduzindo suas atividades a partir de seu próprio consultório ou local de preferência, através da telemedicina.

IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.

REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS: a negociar durante processo seletivo.

Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista e Especialista em Pediatria.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Support Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We're building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?

About you:

This is a direct-hire, high-impact position designed for a support professional who views every interaction as an opportunity to build a relationship. As a Customer Support Specialist, you are the primary face and voice of Smarter Contact across our multiple support channels.

Your mission is to deliver best-in-class customer support while building trust and creating a seamless customer experience. You are not just closing tickets, you are solving complex SMS delivery issues, guiding customers through compliance requirements, and ensuring every interaction is handled with urgency, accuracy, and professionalism while maintaining strong customer satisfaction.

As a frontline representative of the company, you are uniquely positioned to identify customer needs and opportunities to improve retention and account growth. You will help surface opportunities for plan upgrades and add-ons while serving as a first line of defence against churn by identifying customer friction early, escalating issues appropriately, and partnering closely with Success and Product teams to help customers stay successful and engaged.

What You'll Own:

  • Provide high-quality assistance through real-time chat, emails and phone calls, ensuring a seamless experience across all channels.
  • Consistently maintain a CSAT score of over 85% while meeting targets for response times and resolution speed.
  • Achieve monthly revenue quotas by identifying and closing plan upgrades during customer interactions.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all chats, calls, and tasks within the CRM to ensure team-wide visibility.
  • Identify early warning signs like frustration or delivery issues during live chats and resolve them to protect account health.
  • Reinforce the Smarter Contact value proposition and competitive edge in every customer conversation.
  • Capture and relay frontline insights regarding bugs, UX friction, and feature requests to the Product and Leadership teams.
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 8 AM - 8 pm Eastern Standard Time, Monday to Friday

What We're Looking For:

  • 4+ years of experience in Customer Support or CX within a B2B SaaS environment, handling high-volume chat and phone queues.
  • 2+ years of experience supporting US-based customers.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills;
    able to de-escalate, explain complex issues clearly, and drive resolution
  • Proficient or native-level English (full business fluency)
  • A proven track record of identifying expansion opportunities and meeting revenue targets
  • Highly accountable to metrics, with a focus on maintaining consistent KPI improvement.
  • Extremely organized and detail-oriented, ensuring 100% CRM hygiene and adherence to team playbooks/SOPs.
  • Ability to remain composed, professional, and efficient in a fast-paced, high-pressure support environment.
  • Strong business awareness;
    able to identify retention risks and expansion opportunities during support interactions
  • A coachable team player who proactively shares frontline feedback to help improve the product and the support process.

️ Why Smarter Contact?

  • USD base compensation
  • 15 days PTO + 5 sick days + 10 floating holidays (6 weeks off)
  • High autonomy, fast execution, real impact
  • Professional development benefit
  • Wellness benefit
  • Employment anniversary and birthday gift
  • Quarterly health allowance
  • Remote-first team with a strong performance culture
  • This opportunity is offered as a full-time independent contractor role

Please Don't Apply If:

  • You prefer a low-pressure, low-output environment
  • You're not fluent in English or are uncomfortable communicating directly with cross-functional teams
  • You don't meet the minimum customer support experience
  • No experience working for a SaaS company

Ready to grow with us?

We're looking for a proven Customer Support Specialist ready to build the next chapter of their career — and stay for the long haul. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Bookkeeper em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition

Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We've intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work.

At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance, it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive.

We're now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ, this is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You'll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support.

What You'll Do

  • Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Maintain accurate financial data using QuickBooks or other cloud-based accounting tools.
  • Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions.
  • Communicate with clients and team members through Slack, Zoom, and Google Workspace.
  • Use Asana and Everhour to track projects, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency.
  • Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core's quality expectations.

What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English
  • Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting
  • Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time)
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Asana and Everhour or any other workflow automation tools
  • Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana
  • Prior experience working with startups or small businesses

Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Aerial Core, we do things differently:

  • Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload.
  • Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we'll support it.
  • Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success.
  • Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You'll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts.
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained.

The Aerial Core Way

  • Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value.
  • Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights.
  • Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth.
  • Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care.

Ready to do accounting differently?

Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

title: Sr Ai Engineer - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr Ai Engineer - Brazil em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior AI EngineerPITZ | Remote | Reports to CTO A trillion-dollar industry still runs on phone calls. We're building the intelligence that replaces it. PITZ is the infrastructure layer for the global automotive aftermarket. A mechanic speaks — in Spanish, Portuguese, or English, in a noisy shop — and our system diagnoses the failure, identifies the exact part, selects the supplier, underwrites credit, and executes the order. No screen. No typing. No human in the loop. We're live in Mexico and Brazil. Entering the US this year. And we need someone to build the brain behind all of it. Why this role exists We're not hiring a cog for an AI team. There is no AI team yet. You'd be the first dedicated AI hire. You'll work directly with the CEO to design and build the entire intelligence layer — voice pipeline, recommendation engine, credit scoring, and the data flywheel that makes everything compound. If you deliver, you become Head of AI within 12 months. Not as a title bump — because you'll have built the thing from scratch and no one will know it better than you. This is a role for someone who's been a Senior ML Engineer or AI Lead somewhere and knows they're ready for more — but hasn't had the chance to prove it because there's always someone above them. Here, there's no one above you. Just the problem and the product.What you'll buildThe voice-to-action pipeline.Mechanic speech in noisy shops → intent extraction → diagnostic prediction → SKU mapping from millions of parts → order execution. Three languages. Regional slang. Background noise. Real world, not a lab. The recommendation engine.Right part, right seller, right price, right delivery. This is where margin lives. Every percentage point of improvement moves real revenue. The credit scoring models.Behavioral underwriting for mechanics with no credit history. Turn operational data — order frequency, payment patterns, voice engagement — into financial signals. The data flywheel.Every interaction makes the system smarter. You design the architecture that turns daily transactions into compounding intelligence. US market integrations.Connect PITZ to Identifix, ALLDATA, OBD platforms, PartsTech, Mitchell1. Adapt models for the US vehicle fleet and English-speaking mechanics.What you bring3-5 years building ML/AI systems in production.Not notebooks. Not demos. Systems that real users interact with daily and that break in interesting ways. NLP or voice experience.You've worked with speech recognition, intent extraction, text classification, or conversational AI. Bonus if it was in noisy, multilingual, or domain-specific environments. Full-stack ML instincts.You can train a model, build the data pipeline, optimize inference, deploy it, and monitor it. You don't wait for a platform team — you are the platform team. Builder mentality.You've worked in startups or fast-moving environments. You ship fast. You make decisions with 70% of the data. You'd rather build something imperfect today than plan something perfect for next quarter. Fluent English required. Spanish or Portuguese strongly preferred.You'll work with mechanics, ops teams, and partners across three countries.RequirementsTimezone:Must be available during US/LatAm business hours (UTC-3 to UTC-8). This is a real-time collaboration role, not async. Commitment:This is a full-time, dedicated position. If you're currently juggling multiple roles — this isn't a fit. We need 100%. Travel:Periodic travel to Mexico City and São Paulo. You'll visit workshops, hear mechanics, and see the product in action. If you've never left your desk to watch a user interact with your model — this will change that.What makes this different At most companies, a Senior AI Engineer optimizes a model inside a product someone else designed. Here, you design the product. The intelligence layer IS the product. There's no PM handing you a spec. There's no VP of AI telling you the roadmap. You figure out what to build, you build it, and you see it run a real supply chain the next day. You'll work with proprietary data that doesn't exist anywhere else — millions of real mechanic-to-system interactions mapped to parts, orders, payments, and outcomes. Your models get better not because of more compute, but because of more reality. And if you prove you can own this — you lead the team we build around it.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Project Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote position, PJ contract and salary range is 28-35/hr USD.

Required Skills & Experience

- 5+ years in Technical Program Management, Program Management, or Delivery/Project Leadership in software/product environments.

- Strong experience working with engineering teams (front-end, back-end, APIs, integrations) and translating requirements into execution plans.

- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple parallel workstreams with dependencies, ambiguity, and shifting priorities.

- Comfort operating in Agile delivery environments and facilitating common delivery ceremonies.

- Strong ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders—written, verbal, and executive-ready status reporting.

- Proven organizational skills: structured thinking, attention to detail, follow-through, and accountability.

Nice to Have Skills & Experience

- CPG experience (Consumer Packaged Goods) or work supporting enterprise-scale commerce, marketing, or customer platforms.

- Experience using GitHub for product/engineering workflows (issues, epics, project boards, milestones, release tracking).

- AI workflow experience (automation, copilots/assistants, orchestration tools, or applied AI to improve delivery ops).

- Experience supporting digital commerce capabilities (e.G., customer experience, product catalogs, order flows, promotions, personalization, content, analytics).

- Familiarity with Elixir and/or React environments—enough to partner effectively with engineers, understand constraints, and anticipate delivery risks.

Job Description

The Digital Commerce team is seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to amplify product delivery and relieve a Product Manager who is currently balancing product discovery alongside multiple concurrent projects. This TPM will drive program execution across cross-functional teams—translating product intent into clear plans, predictable delivery, and measurable outcomes—while ensuring work is well-managed in GitHub (where our PM workflows now live). This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and operations—bringing structure, visibility, and momentum to complex initiatives, and enabling the PM to focus on customer and market discovery.

- Own end-to-end program management for multiple digital commerce initiatives, from intake through delivery and rollout.

- Build and maintain integrated plans (milestones, dependencies, risks, resourcing, timeline) across product, engineering, data, QA, security, and partner teams.

- Drive delivery rituals: standups, sprint/iteration planning support, backlog readiness, dependency reviews, status reporting, and go/no-go readiness.

- Serve as the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders—ensuring alignment on scope, sequencing, tradeoffs, and "definition of done."

- Proactively manage dependencies, risks, and decisions;
escalate with context and options, not just problems.

- Ensure clear communication across teams and leadership with concise updates and action-oriented readouts.

- Help standardize how initiatives are tracked in GitHub (e.G., issues, epics, project boards, milestones), driving consistent hygiene and visibility.

- Improve team throughput by reducing friction in processes and tooling (templates, workflows, reporting, intake). - Identify opportunities to use AI-enabled workflows to reduce overhead (e.G., release comms drafting, backlog grooming support, automated status summaries, incident triage workflows, documentation acceleration) while maintaining governance and quality.

- Partner with engineering and product to implement pragmatic automation that improves delivery efficiency.

- Coordinate release plans across teams: readiness checklists, rollout sequencing, communication plans, training/support readiness, and post-launch monitoring.

- Ensure operational handoffs and documentation are complete for production support.

title: Médico Pediatra
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico Pediatra em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO PEDIATRA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\ "

Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Pediatria! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.

*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:*

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*

Estamos em busca de Médico/a Pediatra, comprometidos e capacitados para se juntarem à nossa equipe multidisciplinar. Nosso time de médicos desempenham um papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, para sanar suas dúvidas, atender as demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é um profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você!

O médico será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, na modalidade especialidade em Pediatria, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;

PAPEL E RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Pediatria de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.
  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de crianças e adolescentes em suas múltiplas facetas e condições.
  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Pediatria e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.
  • Competência na avaliação pediátrica, incluindo o reconhecimento de problemas e doenças que possam estar presente nesta faixa etária.
  • Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais através de vídeochamada com o responsável.
  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.
  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de acordo com o diagnóstico e faixa etária.
  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.
  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.
  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde da criança e do adolescente.
  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Pediatria.
  • Garantir o respeito ao ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente) com respeito aos seus direitos e prerrogativas para o cuidado em saúde.
  • Realizar consulta individualizada ao adolescente sem necessidade de responsável a partir dos 12 anos de idade conforme previsto pelo ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente), caso solicitado ou quando avaliada necessária.
  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.
  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe crianças e adolescentes a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.
  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.
  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.
  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.
  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.
  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS E PREFERÊNCIAS DE HABILIDADES

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM PEDIATRIA

Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Pediatria - RQE emitido pelo Conselho respectivo;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).

Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Pediatria, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;

Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Médico competente em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de Crianças e Adolescentes.

Competências Comportamentais:

Médico comprometido com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.

Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

Local de Trabalho:

O Médico atuará remotamente, conduzindo suas atividades a partir de seu próprio consultório ou local de preferência, através da telemedicina.

IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.

REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS: a negociar durante processo seletivo.

Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista e Especialista em Pediatria.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arte Finalista (Pleno/Sênior)- Banco De Talentos em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.

O que buscamos:

Estamos em busca de um arte-finalista capaz de trabalhar com rapidez, eficiência e mantendo grande atenção aos detalhes. O profissional deve ser altamente organizado e conseguir trabalhar em mais de um projeto ao mesmo tempo. Entre as atividades, a principal será fazer ajustes e alterações de cor, formato, texto, imagens e preparação dos arquivos para impressão (com sangria, marcas de corte e ficha técnica).

O candidato precisa ter um conhecimento avançado no Adobe InDesign já que 95% do trabalho será feito nele, e o nível de inglês para escrita e interpretação de texto também precisa ser avançado. Num primeiro momento o profissional estará sob supervisão para garantir o entendimento e fluxo de funcionamento do estúdio, mas com o passar do tempo a idéia é ganhar autonomia para realizar as tarefas mais cotidianas e recorrentes sem muita supervisão.

Pré-Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada no segmento impresso e em todos os detalhes que o meio exige (marcas de corte, sangría, margens de segurança, dobras, vinco, cores CMYK, facas especiais, e fichas técnicas);
  • Graduação em Design Gráfico, Desenho Industrial ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência de pelo menos 5+ anos na função como designer gráfico no ramo impresso.
  • Domínio dos software InDesign e illustrator;
  • Inglês avançado(com comprovação via teste ao vivo na segunda etapa do processo);

  • Ter atuado ativamente com fechamento de arquivos, arte-final e preparação de arquivos para impressão.
  • Conhecimento em softwares de gestão de tarefas como Monday ou Trello (aqui utilizamos WorkFront);

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Bookkeeper em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.
