title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Project Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote position, PJ contract and salary range is 28-35/hr USD.

Required Skills & Experience

- 5+ years in Technical Program Management, Program Management, or Delivery/Project Leadership in software/product environments.

- Strong experience working with engineering teams (front-end, back-end, APIs, integrations) and translating requirements into execution plans.

- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple parallel workstreams with dependencies, ambiguity, and shifting priorities.

- Comfort operating in Agile delivery environments and facilitating common delivery ceremonies.

- Strong ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders—written, verbal, and executive-ready status reporting.

- Proven organizational skills: structured thinking, attention to detail, follow-through, and accountability.

Nice to Have Skills & Experience

- CPG experience (Consumer Packaged Goods) or work supporting enterprise-scale commerce, marketing, or customer platforms.

- Experience using GitHub for product/engineering workflows (issues, epics, project boards, milestones, release tracking).

- AI workflow experience (automation, copilots/assistants, orchestration tools, or applied AI to improve delivery ops).

- Experience supporting digital commerce capabilities (e.G., customer experience, product catalogs, order flows, promotions, personalization, content, analytics).

- Familiarity with Elixir and/or React environments—enough to partner effectively with engineers, understand constraints, and anticipate delivery risks.

Job Description

The Digital Commerce team is seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to amplify product delivery and relieve a Product Manager who is currently balancing product discovery alongside multiple concurrent projects. This TPM will drive program execution across cross-functional teams—translating product intent into clear plans, predictable delivery, and measurable outcomes—while ensuring work is well-managed in GitHub (where our PM workflows now live). This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and operations—bringing structure, visibility, and momentum to complex initiatives, and enabling the PM to focus on customer and market discovery.

- Own end-to-end program management for multiple digital commerce initiatives, from intake through delivery and rollout.

- Build and maintain integrated plans (milestones, dependencies, risks, resourcing, timeline) across product, engineering, data, QA, security, and partner teams.

- Drive delivery rituals: standups, sprint/iteration planning support, backlog readiness, dependency reviews, status reporting, and go/no-go readiness.

- Serve as the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders—ensuring alignment on scope, sequencing, tradeoffs, and "definition of done."

- Proactively manage dependencies, risks, and decisions;
escalate with context and options, not just problems.

- Ensure clear communication across teams and leadership with concise updates and action-oriented readouts.

- Help standardize how initiatives are tracked in GitHub (e.G., issues, epics, project boards, milestones), driving consistent hygiene and visibility.

- Improve team throughput by reducing friction in processes and tooling (templates, workflows, reporting, intake). - Identify opportunities to use AI-enabled workflows to reduce overhead (e.G., release comms drafting, backlog grooming support, automated status summaries, incident triage workflows, documentation acceleration) while maintaining governance and quality.

- Partner with engineering and product to implement pragmatic automation that improves delivery efficiency.

- Coordinate release plans across teams: readiness checklists, rollout sequencing, communication plans, training/support readiness, and post-launch monitoring.

- Ensure operational handoffs and documentation are complete for production support.

  • Suportar os processos de gestão, controle e análise das verbas comerciais, assegurando correta alocação, execução e mensuração de retorno (ROI).
  • Monitorar impactos das ações comerciais nos resultados, margens e indicadores financeiros.
  • Analisar e consolidar informações de vendas, custos e despesas, garantindo aderência ao planejado.
  • Produzir relatórios gerenciais de resultados e desempenho financeiro, com análises críticas e recomendações executivas.
  • Realizar apresentações e reuniões com áreas internas para demonstração de resultados, análises financeiras e orçamentárias.
  • Analisar e liberar requisições de compra, conforme políticas internas e orçamento aprovado.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico dos demais membros da equipe de Controladoria, disseminando boas práticas.
  • Executar suas atividades em conformidade com normas técnicas, procedimentos internos, políticas de qualidade, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente.
  • Realizar outras atividades correlatas, compatíveis com o cargo, conforme orientação do superior imediato.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA.
  • Excel avançado incluindo modelagem financeira e construção de modelos de pricing, margem e rentabilidade, uso avançado de funções (ÍNDICE, CORRESP, SOMASES, PROCV/XLOOKUP, SE, MATRIZ, LET, LAMBDA), Tabelas Dinâmicas avançadas, Power Query e Power Pivot para tratamento, consolidação e análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Vivência com planejamento financeiro, orçamento e Forecast, com domínio de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast) e identificação de drivers de resultado.
  • Vivência com custos e formação de preços incluindo conceitos de custo standard, custo médio e margem de contribuição, sistemas de custeio (absorção, real e padrão) e análise de rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal.
  • Experiência com pricing e rentabilidade, com capacidade de modelar preços considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, mix e estratégia comercial, realizar simulações de cenários e análises de impacto econômico-financeiro e suportar negociações comerciais com dados, argumentos e análises estruturadas.
  • Experiência com gestão e controle de verbas comerciais, incluindo análise de retorno sobre investimento (ROI), mensuração de impactos em margem, volume e resultado e acompanhamento da execução orçamentária das ações comerciais.
  • Conhecimento em impostos indiretos (ICMS, PIS, COFINS) e seus impactos na formação de preços, margens e rentabilidade e nos princípios de contabilidade e finanças, com capacidade de análise de demonstrações financeiras, reconhecimento de receitas e despesas e entendimento dos impactos contábeis nas decisões de negócio.
  • Conhecimento do processo comercial e logístico, entendendo seus reflexos em custos, preços, nível de serviço e capital de giro.
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares), com capacidade de construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos, analisar indicadores como margem, pricing waterfall, ROI de verbas comerciais, forecast accuracy e traduzir dados complexos em insights claros para tomada de decisão.
  • Experiência com manipulação e análise de bases de dados massivas, garantindo consistência, rastreabilidade e governança da informação.
  • Experiência com Sistemas Integrados (ERP), com habilidade para extração, validação e cruzamento de dados financeiros e comerciais e entendimento dos impactos de cadastros, condições comerciais e impostos nos resultados.
  • Desejável Inglês (leitura, escrita e conversação).


Aviso Legal:

Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo.   • Google Ads

title: Coordinador De Planeamiento Supply Chain
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Coordinador De Planeamiento Supply Chain em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Empresa con gran trayectoria y de alcance internacional, se encuentra en la búsqueda de un talento:

Coordinador de Planeamiento y Demanda

¿Cuál es la Misión del puesto?

  • Liderar, integrar y hacer eficientes los procesos implicados en la cadena de suministro como son: estimación de la demanda, planificación de la cadena de abastecimiento, compras estratégicas, operaciones de planta y logística y transporte, lo cual implica una interacción y coordinación de acciones constante con los distintos referentes de áreas.
  • Definir el plan de demanda, plan de abastecimiento a los COs, producción y abastecimiento de materias primas e insumos, liderando a su equipo para que se realice de acuerdo a lo acordado.
  • Liderar los planes Estratégicos y planes de mediano y corto plazo de su área, así como liderar y desarrollar a su equipo en pos de la incorporación de prácticas modernas de Planeamiento.
  • Plantear los objetivos del área en forma alineada con los objetivos de la Gerencia de Supply Chain y la Gerencia Corporativa.
  • Liderar y acompañar en la mejora continua del portafolio de la compañía a través del Proceso de Racionalización de SKUs (Cure & Kill) a partir de comités multifuncionales con los diversos actores a lo largo de la Cadena de Suministro.
  • Coordinar con las áreas de la compañía las tareas de limpieza de datos y mejora de procesos de ciclo de vida del producto.
  • Asegurar que no se tengan quiebres a través del correcto balance de producción y abastecimiento a COs oportunamente.
  • Velar por el Working Capital de la compañía a través de la administración de los inventarios de PT, MP y Repuestos.
  • Contribuir y velar por el buen clima laboral, coordinando y participando en las diferentes actividades que se desarrollen en coordinación con las otras jefaturas de la empresa.
  • Cumplir con las políticas y lineamientos de la empresa, del sistema integrado de gestión, política de las 5S, el RIT y el código de ética, así como del marco normativo del gobierno con la finalidad de contribuir con el desarrollo óptimo y adecuado de las diferentes actividades de la organización.

¿Cuáles son los requisitos del puesto?

  • Titulado en Administración, Ingeniería Industriasl o carreras afines.
  • Contar con 3 años de experiencia viendo procesos S&OP y manejo de presupuesto. (Indispensable)
  • Conocimiento en SAP y Office (Indispensable)
  • Nivel de inglés Intermedio/avanzado (Deseable).
  • Conocimientos en gestión de procesos, gestión por competencia y gestión al cambio.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

  • Formar parte de una empresa líder en su sector.
  • Planilla Completa.

title: Analista De Controladoria Sr
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista De Controladoria Sr em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Elaborar e consolidar o orçamento anual da área comercial, bem como prestar suporte na elaboração do orçamento das áreas de Administração de Vendas, Trading, Merchandising e/ou Marketing.
  • Conduzir mensalmente o processo de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast), interagindo com as áreas internas para entendimento dos desvios e proposição de ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Elaborar e atualizar o Forecast, garantindo acuracidade, consistência dos drivers e alinhamento com a estratégia do negócio.
  • Executar e manter as rotinas de pricing da Empresa, assegurando coerência entre custos, margens, impostos, políticas comerciais e estratégia competitiva.
  • Analisar dados de vendas, custos, margens e preços vigentes, recomendando ajustes de preço com base em rentabilidade, elasticidade, posicionamento de mercado e sustentabilidade financeira.
  • Realizar estudos de precificação de novos produtos, considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, benchmark de mercado e impacto no portfólio.
  • Analisar a rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal, recomendando ações para melhoria de margem e mix.
  • Suportar os processos de gestão, controle e análise das verbas comerciais, assegurando correta alocação, execução e mensuração de retorno (ROI).
  • Monitorar impactos das ações comerciais nos resultados, margens e indicadores financeiros.
  • Analisar e consolidar informações de vendas, custos e despesas, garantindo aderência ao planejado.
  • Produzir relatórios gerenciais de resultados e desempenho financeiro, com análises críticas e recomendações executivas.
  • Realizar apresentações e reuniões com áreas internas para demonstração de resultados, análises financeiras e orçamentárias.
  • Analisar e liberar requisições de compra, conforme políticas internas e orçamento aprovado.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico dos demais membros da equipe de Controladoria, disseminando boas práticas.
  • Executar suas atividades em conformidade com normas técnicas, procedimentos internos, políticas de qualidade, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente.
  • Realizar outras atividades correlatas, compatíveis com o cargo, conforme orientação do superior imediato.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA.
  • Excel avançado incluindo modelagem financeira e construção de modelos de pricing, margem e rentabilidade, uso avançado de funções (ÍNDICE, CORRESP, SOMASES, PROCV/XLOOKUP, SE, MATRIZ, LET, LAMBDA), Tabelas Dinâmicas avançadas, Power Query e Power Pivot para tratamento, consolidação e análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Vivência com planejamento financeiro, orçamento e Forecast, com domínio de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast) e identificação de drivers de resultado.
  • Vivência com custos e formação de preços incluindo conceitos de custo standard, custo médio e margem de contribuição, sistemas de custeio (absorção, real e padrão) e análise de rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal.
  • Experiência com pricing e rentabilidade, com capacidade de modelar preços considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, mix e estratégia comercial, realizar simulações de cenários e análises de impacto econômico-financeiro e suportar negociações comerciais com dados, argumentos e análises estruturadas.
  • Experiência com gestão e controle de verbas comerciais, incluindo análise de retorno sobre investimento (ROI), mensuração de impactos em margem, volume e resultado e acompanhamento da execução orçamentária das ações comerciais.
  • Conhecimento em impostos indiretos (ICMS, PIS, COFINS) e seus impactos na formação de preços, margens e rentabilidade e nos princípios de contabilidade e finanças, com capacidade de análise de demonstrações financeiras, reconhecimento de receitas e despesas e entendimento dos impactos contábeis nas decisões de negócio.
  • Conhecimento do processo comercial e logístico, entendendo seus reflexos em custos, preços, nível de serviço e capital de giro.
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares), com capacidade de construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos, analisar indicadores como margem, pricing waterfall, ROI de verbas comerciais, forecast accuracy e traduzir dados complexos em insights claros para tomada de decisão.
  • Experiência com manipulação e análise de bases de dados massivas, garantindo consistência, rastreabilidade e governança da informação.
  • Experiência com Sistemas Integrados (ERP), com habilidade para extração, validação e cruzamento de dados financeiros e comerciais e entendimento dos impactos de cadastros, condições comerciais e impostos nos resultados.
  • Desejável Inglês (leitura, escrita e conversação).

Aviso Legal:

Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.

Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência.

Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Cientista De Dados
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cientista De Dados em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contratação: PJ (7 meses)

Local: 100% remoto

Horário de trabalho: 8h30 -18h

Necessário inglês avançado (conversação)

  • Apoiar análise exploratória de dados e preparação de features usando ferramentas e plataformas aprovadas;

  • Proficiência em SQL e Python ou R para modelagem estatística e manipulação de dados;
  • Experiência prática com GCP (Google Cloud Platform) e BigQuery para análise de dados em larga escala;
  • Experiência commodelos de séries temporais e algoritmos de machine learning (aprendizado supervisionado, não supervisionado, por reforço), trabalhando com diferentes tipos de dados;
  • Forte entendimento de GA4 (Google Analytics 4) e de estruturas de dados de e-commerce;

title: Java Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Java Software Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape.

We're a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we're just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously.

Role Description

We're hiring backend-focused Software Engineers to help build and scale the services that power Theta Data. This is a hands-on coding role. You'll be writing production code from day one. We are looking for self-starting engineers who think deeply about system scale, creatively solve problems, and can move forward in high ambiguity.

You'll join a lean engineering team where your work has a direct, visible impact on the platform and the customers who use it. We have new services to architect, bottlenecks to eliminate, and workflows to redesign from scratch.

Additionally, you'll support live systems, investigate and resolve bugs, and help keep a platform that customers depend on running smoothly.

What you will work on

  • Design, build, and scale backend services handling billions of requests daily
  • Architect new systems and contribute to technical direction
  • Improve and automate customer onboarding workflows
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across the stack
  • Collaborate directly with the team and senior technical leadership

Our Technical Stack

  • Java - core backend services, business logic, API, thick client
  • Python - scripting, tooling
  • Apache Tomcat - servlet container
  • Java Servlets - request handling
  • PostgreSQL + Hibernate
  • gRPC
  • AI coding tools (Claude, Gemini, Copilot) - we use them, you should too

What we are looking for

We hire for fundamentals, ownership, and a love of building. Depending on your experience level, here's what we care about:

Required

  • Deep proficiency in Java with a strong command of the language and ecosystem
  • Proven experience optimizing application performance through JVM heap tuning, garbage collection analysis, and memory allocation strategies
  • Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and systems-level thinking
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, and maintaining REST APIs and backend services
  • Working knowledge of authentication protocols, and modern web architecture

Nice to Have

  • Experience working in data-intensive, low-latency environments where performance matters
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design and query optimization
  • Python development experience for tooling, scripting, or service work
  • Familiarity with Apache Tomcat in production or staging environments
  • Frontend exposure with TypeScript and a modern UI library or framework (Vue, React, or similar)
  • Experience designing or maintaining CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment

Why Theta Data

  • Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast
  • Real engineering challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data
  • High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter and ship quickly
  • Greenfield opportunities: new systems to design, not just legacy to maintain
  • Remote-first: work from anywhere
  • Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily

title: Analista De Controladoria Sr
description:

  • Suportar os processos de gestão, controle e análise das verbas comerciais, assegurando correta alocação, execução e mensuração de retorno (ROI).
  • Monitorar impactos das ações comerciais nos resultados, margens e indicadores financeiros.
  • Analisar e consolidar informações de vendas, custos e despesas, garantindo aderência ao planejado.
  • Produzir relatórios gerenciais de resultados e desempenho financeiro, com análises críticas e recomendações executivas.
  • Realizar apresentações e reuniões com áreas internas para demonstração de resultados, análises financeiras e orçamentárias.
  • Analisar e liberar requisições de compra, conforme políticas internas e orçamento aprovado.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico dos demais membros da equipe de Controladoria, disseminando boas práticas.
  • Executar suas atividades em conformidade com normas técnicas, procedimentos internos, políticas de qualidade, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente.
  • Realizar outras atividades correlatas, compatíveis com o cargo, conforme orientação do superior imediato.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA.
  • Excel avançado incluindo modelagem financeira e construção de modelos de pricing, margem e rentabilidade, uso avançado de funções (ÍNDICE, CORRESP, SOMASES, PROCV/XLOOKUP, SE, MATRIZ, LET, LAMBDA), Tabelas Dinâmicas avançadas, Power Query e Power Pivot para tratamento, consolidação e análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Vivência com planejamento financeiro, orçamento e Forecast, com domínio de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast) e identificação de drivers de resultado.
  • Vivência com custos e formação de preços incluindo conceitos de custo standard, custo médio e margem de contribuição, sistemas de custeio (absorção, real e padrão) e análise de rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal.
  • Experiência com pricing e rentabilidade, com capacidade de modelar preços considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, mix e estratégia comercial, realizar simulações de cenários e análises de impacto econômico-financeiro e suportar negociações comerciais com dados, argumentos e análises estruturadas.
  • Experiência com gestão e controle de verbas comerciais, incluindo análise de retorno sobre investimento (ROI), mensuração de impactos em margem, volume e resultado e acompanhamento da execução orçamentária das ações comerciais.
  • Conhecimento em impostos indiretos (ICMS, PIS, COFINS) e seus impactos na formação de preços, margens e rentabilidade e nos princípios de contabilidade e finanças, com capacidade de análise de demonstrações financeiras, reconhecimento de receitas e despesas e entendimento dos impactos contábeis nas decisões de negócio.
  • Conhecimento do processo comercial e logístico, entendendo seus reflexos em custos, preços, nível de serviço e capital de giro.
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares), com capacidade de construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos, analisar indicadores como margem, pricing waterfall, ROI de verbas comerciais, forecast accuracy e traduzir dados complexos em insights claros para tomada de decisão.
  • Experiência com manipulação e análise de bases de dados massivas, garantindo consistência, rastreabilidade e governança da informação.
  • Experiência com Sistemas Integrados (ERP), com habilidade para extração, validação e cruzamento de dados financeiros e comerciais e entendimento dos impactos de cadastros, condições comerciais e impostos nos resultados.
  • Desejável Inglês (leitura, escrita e conversação).

Aviso Legal:

Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.

Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência.

title: Fx Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Fx Trader em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.

Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.G., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.

Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.

Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.

Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.

Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies

Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent.

You'll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you'll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices.

  • Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.Js/TypeScript that integrate deeply with customer systems.

  • Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform.
  • Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:

Full Stack Engineering

  • Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + VueJS.

AWS native Architecture

  • Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‐optimized.

Systems Integration

  • Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‐specific tools.

Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions.

AI Forward Development

  • Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‐powered workflows into the product.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks.

Identify opportunities to expand AI‐driven automation across the platform.

Collaboration & Impact

  • Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs.
  • Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning.
  • Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows.

What We Are Looking For

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Strong expertise in Node.Js, TypeScript, React, and AWS cloud architecture.
  • Experience building distributed systems, event‐driven architectures, or workflow automation.
  • Comfortable working across the stack (backend‐heavy, but able to contribute to frontend).
  • Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‐technical teams.
  • High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‐moving, ambiguous environments.
  • Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‐to‐day work.
  • Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems.

Why Freight Hero

  • Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2B tech.
  • Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes.
  • Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales.
  • Competitive compensation with performance incentives.
  • Fully remote with a collaborative, high‐performance culture.

title: Fx Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Fx Trader em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.

Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.G., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.

Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.

Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.

Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.

Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.

Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.

Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments

Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior Ai Software Engineer
description:

This is not a traditional backend development role.

Required Qualifications

title: Python Sr (Azure)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Python Sr (Azure) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Python SR (Azure)

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled Python Developer to join our team, with proven experience in building reliable applications in Azure environments. The ideal candidate will also have hands-on knowledge of Infrastructure as Code and be familiar with core Azure services such as Virtual Networks (VNet), Virtual Machines (VMs), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC). Experience in cloning and deploying services efficiently will be highly valued.

While the primary focus is on Azure, familiarity with AWS is considered a plus.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Deploy & Configure Azure Cloud Services such as Virtual Networks (VNet), Virtual Machines (VMs), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC);
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) – Automate infrastructure deployment;
  • CI/CD Pipeline Automation – Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI/CD for automated deployments;
  • Observability &Monitoring – Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions;
  • Disaster Recovery & Security – Develop automated backup strategies, define disaster recovery plans, and implement security best practices;
  • Workflow Automation & Integration – Build integrations to automate deployment processes, security checks, and operational workflows.

Essential Skills

  • Knowledgeable in Linux;
  • DevOps or CloudEngineering experience in a production environment;
  • Cloud Infrastructure Expertise – Hands-on experience with Azure services (Virtual Networks (VNet), Virtual Machines (VMs), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC));
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) – Proficiency in Terraform, Ansible, and Packer for infrastructure automation;
  • CI/CD Pipelines& Automation – Experience setting up Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar tools for automated deployments;
  • Networking & Security – Familiarity with DNS, load balancing, IAM, firewall rules, VPNs, and cloud security best practices;
  • Monitoring & Observability – Experience using Datadog, CloudWatch, Prometheus, ELK Stack, or similar tools for system monitoring and alerting;
  • Scripting & Automation – Proficiency in Python;
  • Agile & DevOps Mindset – Experience working in Agile teams, advocating for DevOps best practices, and continuously improving infrastructure.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with AWS.

About Encora

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world's leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora's technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role OverviewWe are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution. The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.Key Responsibilities Business Development & Partnerships Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered) Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)Market & Network Development Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa) Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscapeExecution & Collaboration Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationshipsBanking & Infrastructure Setup Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlementRequirements 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAMVision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Advanced After Effects Youtube Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Advanced After Effects Youtube Video Editor em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

IMPORTANT: In order to apply, complete the test in After Effects (99% won't do it)! Copy and paste this link into your browser to get started:

If you just use LinkedIn's\ "Easy Apply\" you will not beconsidered for this role.

Overview:

We are 100C ( an 8-person YouTube agency based in the United States that creates and grows YouTube channels for business owners. We need a new ADVANCED YouTube editor experienced in After Effects to take over for one of our well-established clients.

About the role:

We do all of our video editing (except for color grading and sound) in After Effects, so we're looking for a video editor who is skilled with the software. Your role will be handling all the video editing for one of our well-established clients. Your job will include everything necessary to make professional YouTube videos, such as:

  • Color grading
  • Trimming
  • Audio post production
  • Planning the appropriate visuals for each video
  • Finding footage and imagery that match our clients' branding
  • Using AI effectively to generate custom visuals
  • Laying out media
  • Importing and using motion graphic templates
  • Creating custom animations
  • Creating AI avatars (we'll show you how)
  • Finding and editing appropriate music
  • Finding and editing appropriate sound effects
  • Strategic editing (understanding what to cut, what to include, and how to structure it for maximum engagement)

Here is a reel of our work to give you an idea of the type of video editing we do:

Our Values:

It's important that you are in alignment with our values. If this doesn't sound like you, do NOT apply:

  • Quality First - We are a PREMIUM agency, so it's important that you're driven to constantly do your best work and take your skills to the next level. If you're just looking for a job that is easy to do and doesn't require you to think carefully about your editing, this role is NOT for you.
  • High Accountability - You want to take responsibility for your successes AND your failures. If we call you out for doing poor-quality work or delivering late, you have the emotional maturity to take ownership for it and use that to drive you to do better next time.
  • Directness - We don't beat around the bush. If you do great work, we praise you and let you know. Similarly, if something is bad, we tell you it's bad. If you can't take direct criticism, this role is NOT for you.
  • Independence - You are good at solving your own problems. We are here to help, and will go out of our way to train you and make you feel comfortable in your role, but you should be eager to own this position and do it well without us needing to constantly push you.

Additional Requirements:

Below is a list of additional requirements for the job, please read through it carefully before applying:

  • Advanced English proficiency
  • Available the equivalent of full-time (at least 40 hours per week)
  • Willing to work on weekends when necessary
  • Available to start within the next two weeks
  • Advanced After Effects skills: 3D, Rotoscoping, Masking, Motion tracking, Keying, Expressions
  • Have a "design eye": the ability to create and follow aesthetic branding guidelines
  • Professional, meaning you deliver professional-grade work on time
  • Highly responsive

The Offer:

If hired, we will provide free copies of all the plugins we use ($500 in tools), pay for your Magnific (formerly Freepik) and Envato accounts, and teach you how to edit videos in After Effects the same way we do.

Your starting pay will be $1,500-$2,500USD per month depending on your skill level. Location: Brazil (100% Remote)Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years) Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore)Role Summary We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance.Responsibilities Severance Tax Compliance: Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies. Error Detection & Troubleshooting: Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances. PPA Analysis: Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings. Penalty Reduction: Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.G., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3). Process Improvement: Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.Requirements Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details. At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets. Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting. Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors. Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders. A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data. Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.Technical Requirements ERP:SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred). Reporting Tools:Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance.

Responsibilities

  • Severance Tax Compliance: Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies.
  • Error Detection & Troubleshooting: Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances.
  • PPA Analysis: Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings.
  • Penalty Reduction: Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.G., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3).
  • Process Improvement: Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details.
  • At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets.
  • Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting.
  • Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors.
  • Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders.
  • A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data.
  • Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.

Technical Requirements

  • ERP: SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred).
  • Reporting Tools: Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution. The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.Key Responsibilities Business Development & Partnerships Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered) Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)Market & Network Development Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa) Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscapeExecution & Collaboration Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationshipsBanking & Infrastructure Setup Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlementRequirements 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAMVision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Ai Automation Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Automation Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Hey, Dingus!

Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, systems-minded AI Automation Specialist who can build, connect, and scale intelligent workflows that actually work in production.

About Us

Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an "unlimited get-shit-done" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain automated workflows using N8N, connecting APIs, webhooks, and data sources into seamless pipelines.
  • Integrate and prompt Claude (Anthropic) and other LLMs into production systems, not just experiments.
  • Manage and automate data operations in Airtable, including scripted fields, automations, and structured data pipelines.
  • Design AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort across client delivery, internal ops, and content production.
  • Troubleshoot broken pipelines, handle edge cases, and document systems so they don't live only in your head.
  • Collaborate with strategy and delivery teams to identify automation opportunities and scope builds accurately.
  • Stay current on the AI tooling landscape, you should know what's worth using before we ask.
  • Own and iterate on AI agent logic and system prompts, understanding why a workflow behaves the way it does and improving it over time.
  • Build net-new internal AI tools as the business identifies opportunities, not just maintain what exists.

What You Bring

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building automated workflows (N8N, Make.Com, or Zapier, N8N strongly preferred).
  • Real experience integrating LLMs via API (Claude, GPT, or equivalent) into production pipelines with structured outputs.
  • Proficiency in Airtable as a data layer, scripting, automations, relational structures.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and webhook-based integrations.
  • Basic scripting ability in Python or JavaScript, enough to write and debug function nodes without hand-holding.
  • A working understanding of HTML and CSS is imperative, you need to be able to read, interpret, and make sense of front-end structure when workflows touch web-based outputs.
  • A systems thinker mindset: you design the whole loop, not just the happy path.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Comfort with versioning and testing AI outputs, you notice when a prompt change breaks something and know how to fix it.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with vector databases or basic RAG pipelines (Pinecone, Supabase, etc.).
  • Familiarity with AI agent frameworks (LangChain, or equivalent concepts).
  • Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment.
  • Exposure to prompt engineering best practices, like system prompts, chaining, few-shot design.

Work Details

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English

If you're someone who can look at a messy manual process, see the system hiding inside it, and build something that runs without you, we want to hear from you.

Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

Note: Due to the high number of applicants across roles, responses and processes will take a while.

title: Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil (100% Remote)Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years) Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore)Role Summary We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance.Responsibilities Severance Tax Compliance: Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies. Error Detection & Troubleshooting: Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances. PPA Analysis: Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings. Penalty Reduction: Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.G., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3). Process Improvement: Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.Requirements Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details. At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets. Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting. Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors. Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders. A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data. Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.Technical Requirements ERP:SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred). Reporting Tools:Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

title: Consultor Comercial - Feira De Santana
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor Comercial - Feira De Santana em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Nós somos a Cogna, a maior e mais completa empresa de serviços educacionais do país.

Com quase 60 anos de história e mais de 60 marcas, atuamos de forma ampla e integrada, com soluções para escolas, governos e estudantes dos 2 aos 100 anos.

Entre nossas marcas estão Anglo, Red Balloon e Anhanguera, além das editoras Ática, Saraiva, Scipione, que refletem a diversidade e a força do nosso ecossistema educacional.

Contamos com mais de 26 mil colaboradores e o nosso propósito é claro: oferecer soluções educacionais que impulsionam pessoas e organizações a construírem uma melhor versão de si.

Quer fazer parte de um time que inova e impacta milhões? Sua jornada começa aqui!

Como Pessoa Consultora Comercial você vai:

  • Executar ativações comerciais em empresas, órgãos públicos, escolas e eventos em geral para promoção e divulgação da marca com foco em captação;
  • Ser responsável pela gestão do funil de vendas;
  • Desenvolver sua rede digital de captação, gerando novos leads, através de eventos, lives, publicação de conteúdo, ebooks, cursos livres e webinar;
  • Ser responsável pela gestão dos indicadores comerciais;
  • Realizar prospecção de clientes;
  • Atender com foco na experiência do aluno/candidato;
  • Terá atuação interna e externa.

É importante que você tenha:

  • Ensino Médio completo ou superior desejável;
  • Experiência na área comercial com foco em PAP;
  • Veículo próprio e CNH;
  • Pacote officebásico.

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Vale Alimentação: benefício para auxiliar nas despesas com alimentação e garantir mais praticidade no seu dia a dia.
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica: cuidado com a sua saúde e bem-estar, oferecendo suporte médico e odontológico para você e sua família.
  • Auxílio Combustível: apoio para facilitar o deslocamento para as ações externas, contribuindo com os custos de combustível.
  • Vale Transporte: benefício destinado ao deslocamento diário, proporcionando mais comodidade e segurança no trajeto casa-trabalho.

Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.
  • Seguro de Vida: Este beneficio é compulsório, a todos os colaboradores CLT, sem custo, e estão inclusos na apólice de seguro, a partir da sua data de admissão.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Java Developer - Relocation To Portugal em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.

What are we looking for?

  • We are looking for experienced Java Developers to join an international and dynamic environment.
  • The ideal candidate has at least 5 years of experience in Java development, with solid exposure to modern technologies and implementation projects.
  • Fluency in English (minimum B2 level) is required.
  • Strong experience with Java, Spring Boot, microservices architecture, and cloud environments.
  • Experience working with recent technology stacks and participating in implementation projects is highly valued.
  • Williness to relocate to Portugal

What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee– our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;

  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid.

What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;

  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;

  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.

Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to: .

title: Professor De Espanhol
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor De Espanhol em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

Necessário:

  • Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente
