title: Senior Ml Engineer | Fully Remote | B2b
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Ml Engineer | Fully Remote | B2b em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence.This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly.About us Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2B company intelligence platform. We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer. The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages.Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, DevOps and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product. The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well. This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously.Role description As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo's product.Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection. You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale.The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, SageMaker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and TypeScript. You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation.Your work includes:
- Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection
- Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats
- Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production
- Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases
- Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value
- Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling
- Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time
- Working with AWS services such as Lambda, SageMaker, S3 and ECS
- Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flowsThis role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them.Requirements You bring:
- At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience
- Strong Python skills
- Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3
- Real production experience with ML on AWS
- Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning
- Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data
- Experience with JSON, NoSQL data and scraped web content
- A strong eye for correctness and data quality
- Business level English
- The ability to work independently in a small remote team
- A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownershipConditions
- 12 month B2B contract
- Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap
- Flat structure with direct communication
- Production product with real users and real data problems
- Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence
- Compensation based on senior contractor levelThe hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team.Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo's needs.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Tomada de decisões tecnológicas, mentoria de equipes e resolução de problemas complexos em produção.

title: Cloud Systems Engineer/Devops
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Systems Engineer/Devops em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.

Role Overview

We are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration;
you must be capable of building architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.

The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.

The role's primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration

strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.
  • Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.
  • VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN, pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.
  • Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.
  • Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.
  • Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Security & Compliance: Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter

Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.
  • Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.
  • Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.
  • Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.
  • Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)

Nice-to-Have

  • PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.
  • Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.
  • Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.

We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

description:

About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.

Role Overview

We are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration;
you must be capable of building architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.

The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.

The role's primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration

strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.
  • Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.
  • VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN, pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.
  • Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.
  • Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.
  • Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Security & Compliance: Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter

Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.
  • Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.
  • Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.
  • Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.
  • Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)

Nice-to-Have

  • PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.
  • Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.
  • Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.

We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

O(a) profissional ideal é um(a) consultor(a) funcional sênior, com domínio dos processos de supply chain e manutenção — incluindo estrutura de ativos, manutenção preventiva e corretiva, ordens de serviço, peças de reposição, estoque, compras e integração de custos.

Esta é uma posição funcional sênior, com responsabilidade de conduzir workshops, levantar e desafiar requisitos de negócio, desenhar processos TO-BE, configurar o Dynamics 365 SCM, apoiar testes e atuar lado a lado com stakeholders de negócio e times técnicos.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir workshops funcionais com áreas de manutenção, operações, supply chain, compras, estoque, armazém, produção e finanças.
  • Analisar processos AS-IS e desenhar processos TO-BE para Asset Management e operações de manutenção.
  • Configurar o Microsoft Dynamics 365 SCM, com foco no módulo de Asset Management.
  • Atuar com ativos, localizações funcionais, solicitações de manutenção, ordens de serviço, planos de manutenção, manutenção preventiva e corretiva e processos de peças de reposição.
  • Apoiar a integração entre Asset Management e os processos de estoque, compras, armazém, produção, custos e finanças.
  • Realizar análises fit-gap e elaborar documentação de design funcional.
  • Apoiar atividades de migração de dados (ativos, planos de manutenção, ordens de serviço, peças e histórico).
  • Definir e executar cenários de teste funcional, apoiar UAT, resolução de issues, cutover, go-live e hypercare.
  • Colaborar com desenvolvedores, arquitetos de solução, gerentes de projeto e stakeholders de negócio.
  • Recomendar boas práticas para Dynamics 365 SCM e processos de Asset Management.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sênior como consultor(a) funcional em Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations / Supply Chain Management.
  • Experiência hands-on em configuração do Dynamics 365 SCM.
  • Vivência em Asset Management, Enterprise Asset Management, manutenção industrial ou plant maintenance.
  • Forte entendimento de processos de manutenção: preventiva, corretiva, ordens de serviço, planejamento de manutenção, hierarquia de ativos e consumo de peças.
  • Experiência integrando Asset Management com compras, estoque, armazém, produção, custos ou finanças.
  • Capacidade de liderar workshops e se comunicar com stakeholders sêniores.
  • Experiência em elaboração de especificações funcionais, documentação de processos, scripts de teste e materiais de apoio a UAT.
  • Inglês fluente (mandatório) para reuniões, documentação e interação com times globais.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em ambiente de consultoria / projeto.

Diferenciais

  • Certificação Microsoft em Dynamics 365 SCM (MB-330 ou similares).
  • Experiência em setores industrial, manufatura, utilities, mineração, óleo & gás, logística ou facilities.
  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI, integrações, IoT ou sistemas externos de manutenção.
  • Experiência com migração de dados, planejamento de cutover e suporte a go-live.
  • Conhecimento em SAP PM, SAP EAM, Maximo, Infor EAM ou outros sistemas EAM.

Perfil

Buscamos um(a) profissional funcional sênior, capaz de traduzir requisitos de negócio de manutenção e supply chain em configuração e design funcional no Dynamics 365 SCM. Conhecimento técnico é bem-vindo, mas o foco principal está na expertise funcional em Dynamics 365 SCM e Asset Management.

title: Integration Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Integration Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We've built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we're revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI.

We're growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates NEA, and Neo along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI.

Anterior is improving the experience of healthcare for everyone. We're working on the cutting edge of using technology to make clinical decision-making frictionless.We're building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow.

The Team

At Anterior, engineers share a strong "sense of product" and solve meaningful problems that simplify healthcare workflows. We collaborate in multidisciplinary teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused solutions guided by best practices and modular design.

We're building a dedicated deployments team focused on deploying our platform into large US enterprise healthcare environments. This team works closely with customers and our core platform engineers to ensure seamless, reliable integrations into complex payer systems of record.

About You

You have a passion for doing things The Right Way, you believe Less is More, you want to focus on the foundations of system design and architecture (pacelc, consistency guarantees), you care as much about the code you do not write, you're tired of the hype treadmill and care about the fundamentals. You have battle scars from over-engineered and underperforming slop, and you care about writing code that lasts.

Your depth is in building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect complex systems together reliably. You've worked with enterprise customers, dealt with messy data, conflicting sources of truth, and deduplication challenges.

You've owned integration design decisions end-to-end — from scoping requirements with a customer to shipping it to production and making sure it holds up. You may be coming from a health tech company, a scale-up doing enterprise deployments, or a platform team that built the connective tissue between systems — what matters is that you've navigated real integration complexity and you want ownership over what you build.

About the Role

Members of Technical Staff (Deployments) at Anterior own customer deployment problems end-to-end — from scoping integrations through to production. You'll be the bridge between our AI platform and the enterprise healthcare systems it plugs into.

A day's work may include:

  • Designing and building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect our platform to customer systems of record EHRs, claims platforms, care management systems)
  • Working directly with US enterprise healthcare customers to understand their architecture, scope integration requirements, and translate them into technical specs
  • Building and maintaining FHIR, HL7, and custom API integrations with payer and health plan systems
  • Debugging data quality issues — conflicting sources of truth, deduplication, schema mismatches, and edge cases specific to healthcare data
  • Owning UAT testing end-to-end, working with customer IT teams to validate data flows before go-live
  • Building internal tooling and shared integration patterns that make the next deployment faster
  • Contributing to Anterior's SDKs, developer documentation, and integration playbooks
  • Collaborating closely with the core platform team in New York to ensure integration needs inform platform architecture

Tech

  • Langs: Python / TS
  • Infra: Nix, AWS
  • Healthcare data: FHIR, HL7 (experience preferred but not required — you'll learn fast if you have strong API and data pipeline fundamentals)

What we're looking for

  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, distributed systems
  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems, ideally in healthcare (payer, EHR, claims) but complex enterprise integrations in other industries count too
  • Comfort working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into clean technical solutions
  • Experience with data quality challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth
  • Strong written and spoken communication in English — you'll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones
  • Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early
  • Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours

What's in it for you

This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You'll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly.

We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

  • Organização, disciplina e foco em resultados

Become a Compasser, be part of AI/R.

Compass UOL is a global firm and part of the AI Revolution Company, together transforming organizations using Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and other of today's most advanced technologies.

We equip our team with proprietary and external AI-driven tools to design and build digital-native platforms, integrating cutting-edge technologies and enabling companies to innovate, transform their businesses, and drive success in their markets.

To achieve this, we attract and develop the best talent, creating opportunities that enhance people's lives and highlight the positive impact of disruptive technologies.

We empower borderless talent and promote knowledge and opportunities in the latest market trends, driving significant personal and professional growth.

title: Senior Cisco Ucs Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Cisco Ucs Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Infrastructure Engineer - Cisco UCS expert to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US.

MUST BE fluent in English.

The Senior Infrastructure Engineer provides advanced technical expertise within the Managed Services organization and serves as a senior escalation point for complex infrastructure issues. This role is primarily focused on Cisco UCS compute, VMware vCenter/vSphere virtualization, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (VDI) environments.

In addition to resolving advanced incidents, this role contributes to technical leadership, root cause analysis, documentation, and the planning and implementation of infrastructure solutions delivered through Professional Services engagements.

Senior Infrastructure Engineers are expected to have deep expertise in the core technology areas listed below, with a broad understanding of adjacent infrastructure disciplines.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the full lifecycle of complex infrastructure incidents, from detection through resolution and post-incident review, ensuring accountability for technical outcomes, stability, and documentation.
  • Lead investigation and resolution of critical incidents, driving coordination across internal teams, vendors, and customer stakeholders.
  • Make technical decisions and take end-to-end ownership of infrastructure issues, driving resolution without reliance on further escalation.
  • Lead technical delivery of infrastructure projects, including scoping, estimation, design, and implementation.
  • Perform root cause analysis and develop long-term remediation strategies to prevent recurrence.
  • Validate and approve infrastructure changes, designs, and remediation strategies.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers.
  • Contribute to architecture documentation, diagrams, and operational runbooks.
  • Design and implement automation and process improvements to enhance reliability and operational efficiency.
  • Participate in change management and project planning activities.
  • Accurately track time and project activities within the company's time tracking system.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of IT Infrastructure experience.
  • MUST BE fluent in English.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with Cisco UCS — including blade/rack server administration, Fabric Interconnects, UCS Manager (UCSM) or Intersight, service profiles, and firmware management.
  • Deep experience with VMware vCenter and vSphere — including ESXi administration, vMotion, HA/DRS, distributed virtual switches, and VM lifecycle management.
  • Deep experience with Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD) or Citrix DaaS — including Delivery Controllers, StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, machine catalogs, and VDA troubleshooting.
  • Strong experience troubleshooting complex multi-system infrastructure issues.
  • Experience designing and implementing infrastructure solutions.

Preferred

  • Experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM) and enterprise voice/unified communications infrastructure.
  • Certifications such as Cisco CCNP/CCIE Data Center, VMware VCP-DCV, Citrix CCP-V, or equivalent cloud infrastructure certifications.
  • Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models.
  • Experience delivering customer-facing IT infrastructure projects.
  • Experience with enterprise storage platforms.
  • Familiarity with identity platforms (Active Directory, Okta), firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco FTD), and backup/disaster recovery solutions is a plus.

title: Acquisition Editor, Life Sciences
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Acquisition Editor, Life Sciences em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators, and students worldwide use JoVE for their research, teaching, and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including leaders such as Universidad de São Paulo, Universidade Estadual Paulista, Fundação Oswaldo Fiocruz and more. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India, servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.

The Role

We are seeking an ambitious individual to join our team as an Acquisition Editor. In this role, you will focus on recruiting new authors and content for our Journal.

Responsibilities:

  • Identify and recruit new authors, guiding them through the manuscript submission process for JoVE Journal.
  • Contact potential Guest Editors and collaborate with them to build a Methods Collections, our version of a special issue.
  • Establish and maintain a strong network of scientists/journal authors to drive content acquisition and grow submission rates.
  • Collaborate with the peer review team to facilitate the publication of manuscripts.
  • Meet or exceed monthly acquisition targets.

Requirements:

  • A Ph.D. in the Life Sciences.
  • Fluent English written and verbal communication skills.
  • Results-driven, with an ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational, influencing and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with the publishing process is a plus.

Why Join JoVE?

  • You can expect compensation competitively placed within the local market, including unlimited bonus for manuscript acquisition.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and discovery.
  • Opportunity to work in a remote environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Integration Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Integration Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We've built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we're revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI.

We're growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates NEA, and Neo along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI.

Anterior is improving the experience of healthcare for everyone. We're working on the cutting edge of using technology to make clinical decision-making frictionless.We're building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow.

The Team

At Anterior, engineers share a strong "sense of product" and solve meaningful problems that simplify healthcare workflows. We collaborate in multidisciplinary teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused solutions guided by best practices and modular design.

We're building a dedicated deployments team focused on deploying our platform into large US enterprise healthcare environments. This team works closely with customers and our core platform engineers to ensure seamless, reliable integrations into complex payer systems of record.

About You

You have a passion for doing things The Right Way, you believe Less is More, you want to focus on the foundations of system design and architecture (pacelc, consistency guarantees), you care as much about the code you do not write, you're tired of the hype treadmill and care about the fundamentals. You have battle scars from over-engineered and underperforming slop, and you care about writing code that lasts.

Your depth is in building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect complex systems together reliably. You've worked with enterprise customers, dealt with messy data, conflicting sources of truth, and deduplication challenges.

You've owned integration design decisions end-to-end — from scoping requirements with a customer to shipping it to production and making sure it holds up. You may be coming from a health tech company, a scale-up doing enterprise deployments, or a platform team that built the connective tissue between systems — what matters is that you've navigated real integration complexity and you want ownership over what you build.

About the Role

Members of Technical Staff (Deployments) at Anterior own customer deployment problems end-to-end — from scoping integrations through to production. You'll be the bridge between our AI platform and the enterprise healthcare systems it plugs into.

A day's work may include:

  • Designing and building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect our platform to customer systems of record EHRs, claims platforms, care management systems)
  • Working directly with US enterprise healthcare customers to understand their architecture, scope integration requirements, and translate them into technical specs
  • Building and maintaining FHIR, HL7, and custom API integrations with payer and health plan systems
  • Debugging data quality issues — conflicting sources of truth, deduplication, schema mismatches, and edge cases specific to healthcare data
  • Owning UAT testing end-to-end, working with customer IT teams to validate data flows before go-live
  • Building internal tooling and shared integration patterns that make the next deployment faster
  • Contributing to Anterior's SDKs, developer documentation, and integration playbooks
  • Collaborating closely with the core platform team in New York to ensure integration needs inform platform architecture

Tech

  • Langs: Python / TS
  • Infra: Nix, AWS
  • Healthcare data: FHIR, HL7 (experience preferred but not required — you'll learn fast if you have strong API and data pipeline fundamentals)

What we're looking for

  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, distributed systems
  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems, ideally in healthcare (payer, EHR, claims) but complex enterprise integrations in other industries count too
  • Comfort working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into clean technical solutions
  • Experience with data quality challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth
  • Strong written and spoken communication in English — you'll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones
  • Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early
  • Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours

What's in it for you

This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You'll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly.

We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

Senior AI‐Native Backend Engineer (Java | 10+ Years Experience)

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior AI‐Native Backend Engineer with deep expertise in Java to design, build, and operate scalable, secure, and compliant backend systems that power agentic AI workflows.

This role is central to enabling AI‐driven decision pipelines by integrating internal AI platforms (e.G., NASH), external AI services, enterprise data sources, and compliance systems through well‐orchestrated backend services.

The ideal candidate combines strong Java engineering fundamentals, distributed systems expertise, and hands‐on experience implementing AI orchestration, rule application, and explainable decision flows in regulated, enterprise environments.

Key Responsibilities

AI‐Native Backend & Agentic Orchestration

Design, build, and maintain backend services in Java that support agentic AI pipelines

Implement agentic workflows that route content and data through internal AI platforms (e.G., NASH), applying compliance rules, metadata, and review logic

Develop APIs and services that enable:

Context enrichment

Rule evaluation

Decision orchestration

Explainable AI outcomes

Orchestrate interactions between:

Internal AI platforms (NASH)

External AI services (Azure AI, AWS AI)

Enterprise data and compliance systems

Architecture & Distributed Systems

Lead architectural discussions for AI‐driven backend platforms

Design scalable, resilient, and secure microservices architectures

Ensure high performance, reliability, and fault tolerance in production AI workflows

Apply solid object‐oriented design, design patterns, and domain‐driven principles

Governance, Compliance & Security

Embed governance, auditability, traceability, and explainability into all AI‐enabled backend services

Ensure secure data handling and compliance with enterprise and regulatory standards

Implement logging, monitoring, and audit trails for AI‐driven decisions

Enforce backend security best practices (OAuth2, JWT, secure API design)

Engineering Excellence & Collaboration

Write clean, maintainable, and well‐tested Java code following best practices

Perform code reviews and raise engineering standards across teams

Collaborate with frontend, AI, data, product, and compliance teams

Mentor junior and mid‐level engineers

Actively contribute to Agile/Scrum ceremonies and continuous improvement

Required Qualifications and Experience

10+ years of professional experience in Java backend development

Strong expertise in core Java (Java 8+)

Proven experience building enterprise‐grade, distributed systems

Strong experience with RESTful APIs and microservices

Hands‐on experience developing backend integration services and orchestration layers

Solid understanding of:

Object‐oriented design

Design patterns

Software engineering best practices

Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle)

Proficiency with Git, Maven/Gradle, and CI/CD pipelines

Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization skills

Preferred Skills and Technologies

Frameworks: Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Cloud

Experience supporting or integrating AI/ML and LLM‐based systems

Familiarity with agentic AI workflows and AI orchestration concepts

Cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, or GCP

Containerization & orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes

Messaging systems: Kafka, RabbitMQ

NoSQL databases: MongoDB, Cassandra

Monitoring & observability: Prometheus, ELK stack, Splunk

Understanding of AI governance, compliance, and responsible AI practices

Frontend exposure (Angular, React) is a plus for cross‐stack collaboration

Soft Skills and Competencies

Strong analytical and problem‐solving skills

Excellent communication and collaboration abilities

Proven leadership in technical discussions and system design

High ownership and accountability

Ability to work independently and in cross‐functional teams

Adaptability and continuous learning mindset

Strong organizational and time‐management skills

Education Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field

Master's degree is a plus

ITTConnect is seeking aSenior Network Engineerto work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US.MUST BE fluent in English.The Senior Network Engineer provides advanced networking expertise within the Managed Services organization and serves as a subject matter expert and senior escalation point for complex network and firewall issues. In addition to resolving advanced incidents, this role contributes to technical leadership, root cause analysis, documentation, and the planning and implementation of network solutions delivered through Professional Services engagements. Senior Network Engineers are expected to have deep expertise in enterprise networking and advanced firewall management across multiple platforms, with a strong focus on security, stability, and scalability of client environments.Key Responsibilities: Own the full lifecycle of complex network and firewall incidents, from detection through resolution and post-incident review, ensuring accountability for technical outcomes, stability, and documentation. Lead investigation and resolution of critical network incidents, driving coordination across internal teams, vendors, and customer stakeholders. Make technical decisions and take end-to-end ownership of network issues, driving resolution without reliance on further escalation. Lead technical delivery of network projects, including scoping, estimation, design, and implementation. Perform root cause analysis and develop long-term remediation strategies to prevent recurrence. Validate and approve network changes, designs, and remediation strategies. Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Cisco, Palo Alto, and Fortinet networking and firewall equipment. Conduct targeted cleanup and improvements of existing network environments to ensure stability and scalability, minimizing customer downtime. Collaborate with the security team to ensure proper network hardening is in place and that all risks are properly mitigated or remediated. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers. Contribute to architecture documentation, diagrams, and operational runbooks. Maintain awareness of developments within the networking and security technology landscape, recommending new solutions when necessary. Accurately track time and project activities within the company's time tracking system.Requirements 10+ years of experience within an MSP, VAR, ISP, NOC, or enterprise IT environment, with a focus on troubleshooting and maintaining existing network infrastructure. MUST BE fluent in English. Advanced, hands-on experience managing enterprise firewalls across multiple platforms — including Cisco (ASA/FTD/FMC), Palo Alto Networks (PAN-OS, Panorama), and Fortinet (FortiGate, FortiManager) — including policy design, rule optimization, VPN configuration, and threat prevention. Strong knowledge of networking protocols and technologies including TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, IPSec, SNMP, STP, VTP, and VLANs. Strong knowledge of network infrastructure within virtualized environments using VMware or similar platforms, including virtual networking, VLAN configurations, virtual switches, and network segmentation. Experience troubleshooting performance and connectivity issues across different OSI layers. Experience with application-level network troubleshooting, including packet inspection and analysis. Proven experience optimizing, securing, and consolidating complex legacy network environments to meet current and future business needs. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a customer-first approach to resolving network issues.Preferred Active CCNP certification or equivalent (Palo Alto PCNSE or Fortinet NSE 4/7 also valued). Experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM) and enterprise voice/unified communications infrastructure. Experience with cloud networking across AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including networking configurations, security settings, and integration with on-premises environments. Experience with network security practices including network hardening, monitoring, and threat assessment. Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models. Experience delivering customer-facing IT network projects. A degree or equivalent experience in computer science or a related field.

description:

K-POP & K-DRAMA Influencer Growth CreatorPowered by IZISURFAbout IZISURFIZISURF is building a next-generation creator growth ecosystem focused on K-POP, K-Drama, Korean entertainment, and global fan communities. Our mission is to help passionate creators transform their content into scalable global media brands through audience growth, AI-powered optimization, fan engagement strategies, and cross-platform expansion.We believe that the future of entertainment media belongs to creators who deeply understand fandom culture, digital storytelling, and internet trends. As Korean entertainment continues to influence global culture, we are creating an infrastructure that helps influencers grow faster, engage audiences more effectively, and unlock meaningful monetization opportunities. Unlike traditional influencer agencies, IZISURF operates as a creator growth partner. We actively work alongside creators to optimize content performance, identify viral opportunities, improve audience retention, and expand creator reach across multiple social media platforms. Our goal is not only to help creators gain followers, but to help them build long-term digital brands with sustainable growth. Position OverviewWe are looking for highly creative, trend-aware, and passionate K-POP & K-Drama Influencer Growth Creators who are excited about Korean entertainment culture and want to build a strong global online presence. This role is ideal for individuals who genuinely enjoy discussing K-POP groups, idols, dramas, entertainment news, fan theories, comeback analysis, performances, concerts, and online fandom culture. Whether you are already an influencer or an emerging creator with strong potential, we are interested in working with people who can create authentic and engaging content that resonates with audiences worldwide. As part of IZISURF, creators will receive strategic support designed to accelerate growth. Our team helps creators improve audience engagement, optimize content formats, analyze performance metrics, and identify viral content opportunities. We work collaboratively with creators to develop sustainable content strategies rather than focusing only on short-term trends. ResponsibilitiesThe selected creator will regularly produce engaging content related to K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, entertainment culture, idol trends, music releases, and fan discussions. Content may include reactions, commentary, reviews, rankings, livestream discussions, entertainment analysis, short-form videos, and community engagement activities. Creators will publish content across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, YouTube, X (Twitter), Threads, and other emerging media channels. The role requires staying highly informed about ongoing entertainment trends, comeback schedules, drama releases, viral online discussions, and fandom activities. In addition to content production, creators will collaborate closely with the IZISURF growth team to improve visibility and engagement. This includes reviewing analytics, refining content strategy, experimenting with new content formats, and participating in cross-platform growth campaigns. We encourage creators to continuously evolve their personal brand while maintaining authenticity and strong audience connection. Creators may also participate in brand collaborations, entertainment campaigns, livestream events, fan engagement projects, and promotional activities related to Korean entertainment and digital culture. What Makes This Opportunity DifferentAt IZISURF, we do not simply recruit influencers — we actively help creators grow. Our team provides strategic support in audience development, content optimization, social media analytics, trend intelligence, and creator branding. We help creators identify what content performs best, how to improve audience retention, and how to scale engagement across multiple platforms. Creators working with IZISURF may gain access to growth resources, collaboration opportunities, creator partnerships, AI-assisted content workflows, monetization strategies, and entertainment-related campaigns designed to increase visibility and accelerate growth. We believe that many talented creators struggle not because of creativity, but because they lack access to proper growth infrastructure. IZISURF is designed to solve that problem by combining entertainment culture expertise with modern digital growth systems. Preferred QualificationsWe are looking for individuals who are highly passionate about Korean entertainment culture and actively follow K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, and fandom communities. Strong communication skills, creativity, consistency, and comfort appearing on camera are highly valuable for this role. Experience with social media content creation is preferred, but we are also open to emerging creators who demonstrate strong potential, personality, and storytelling ability. Familiarity with short-form video platforms, editing tools, and internet culture trends is important. Candidates who already maintain active social media accounts, fan communities, or entertainment-focused content channels are strongly encouraged to apply. Korean language skills are a plus but are not required. Ideal CandidateThe ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys talking about Korean entertainment and naturally engages with online communities. You are someone who understands internet culture, stays updated on trends, and enjoys creating content that sparks discussion and engagement. You are creative, ambitious, and interested in building a long-term digital presence rather than simply posting occasional entertainment updates. You are excited about growing alongside a team that actively supports creator development and digital brand expansion. Most importantly, you understand fandom culture and can create content that feels authentic, relatable, and engaging to global audiences.

Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a customer-first approach to resolving network issues.Preferred Active CCNP certification or equivalent (Palo Alto PCNSE or Fortinet NSE 4/7 also valued). Experience with cloud networking across AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including networking configurations, security settings, and integration with on-premises environments. Experience with network security practices including network hardening, monitoring, and threat assessment. Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models. Experience delivering customer-facing IT network projects. A degree or equivalent experience in computer science or a related field.

As Korean entertainment continues to influence global culture, we are creating an infrastructure that helps influencers grow faster, engage audiences more effectively, and unlock meaningful monetization opportunities. Unlike traditional influencer agencies, IZISURF operates as a creator growth partner. We actively work alongside creators to optimize content performance, identify viral opportunities, improve audience retention, and expand creator reach across multiple social media platforms. Our goal is not only to help creators gain followers, but to help them build long-term digital brands with sustainable growth. This role is ideal for individuals who genuinely enjoy discussing K-POP groups, idols, dramas, entertainment news, fan theories, comeback analysis, performances, concerts, and online fandom culture. Whether you are already an influencer or an emerging creator with strong potential, we are interested in working with people who can create authentic and engaging content that resonates with audiences worldwide. As part of IZISURF, creators will receive strategic support designed to accelerate growth. Our team helps creators improve audience engagement, optimize content formats, analyze performance metrics, and identify viral content opportunities. We work collaboratively with creators to develop sustainable content strategies rather than focusing only on short-term trends. ResponsibilitiesThe selected creator will regularly produce engaging content related to K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, entertainment culture, idol trends, music releases, and fan discussions. Content may include reactions, commentary, reviews, rankings, livestream discussions, entertainment analysis, short-form videos, and community engagement activities. Creators will publish content across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, YouTube, X (Twitter), Threads, and other emerging media channels. The role requires staying highly informed about ongoing entertainment trends, comeback schedules, drama releases, viral online discussions, and fandom activities. In addition to content production, creators will collaborate closely with the IZISURF growth team to improve visibility and engagement. This includes reviewing analytics, refining content strategy, experimenting with new content formats, and participating in cross-platform growth campaigns. We encourage creators to continuously evolve their personal brand while maintaining authenticity and strong audience connection. Creators may also participate in brand collaborations, entertainment campaigns, livestream events, fan engagement projects, and promotional activities related to Korean entertainment and digital culture. What Makes This Opportunity DifferentAt IZISURF, we do not simply recruit influencers — we actively help creators grow. Our team provides strategic support in audience development, content optimization, social media analytics, trend intelligence, and creator branding. We help creators identify what content performs best, how to improve audience retention, and how to scale engagement across multiple platforms. Creators working with IZISURF may gain access to growth resources, collaboration opportunities, creator partnerships, AI-assisted content workflows, monetization strategies, and entertainment-related campaigns designed to increase visibility and accelerate growth. We believe that many talented creators struggle not because of creativity, but because they lack access to proper growth infrastructure. IZISURF is designed to solve that problem by combining entertainment culture expertise with modern digital growth systems. Preferred QualificationsWe are looking for individuals who are highly passionate about Korean entertainment culture and actively follow K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, and fandom communities. Strong communication skills, creativity, consistency, and comfort appearing on camera are highly valuable for this role. Experience with social media content creation is preferred, but we are also open to emerging creators who demonstrate strong potential, personality, and storytelling ability. Familiarity with short-form video platforms, editing tools, and internet culture trends is important. Candidates who already maintain active social media accounts, fan communities, or entertainment-focused content channels are strongly encouraged to apply. Korean language skills are a plus but are not required. Ideal CandidateThe ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys talking about Korean entertainment and naturally engages with online communities. You are someone who understands internet culture, stays updated on trends, and enjoys creating content that sparks discussion and engagement. You are creative, ambitious, and interested in building a long-term digital presence rather than simply posting occasional entertainment updates. You are excited about growing alongside a team that actively supports creator development and digital brand expansion. Most importantly, you understand fandom culture and can create content that feels authentic, relatable, and engaging to global audiences.

Fundados em 1996, somos líderes na fabricação e na distribuição de materiais e medicamentos para o segmento da saúde, com produtos e soluções para todo o Brasil. Requisitos:

  • Graduação completa e tecnólogo completo;
  • Vivência comprovada em vendas externas e relacionamento com clientes;

title: Ai Software Engineer (Full-Stack)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Software Engineer (Full-Stack) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Sobre a posição

Estamos buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Software Full-Stack Sênior para atuar no desenvolvimento de produtos que combinam infraestrutura crítica com Inteligência Artificial, em um ambiente onde segurança, escala e performance não são negociáveis.

Você vai liderar o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento, do desenho de interfaces à arquitetura de backend, com integração direta a soluções de IA. Se você tem visão de produto, autonomia técnica e pensa em sistemas antes de pensar em código, queremos conversar.

Principais responsabilidades
  • Liderar o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento full-stack: desde interfaces até backend, integrações com modelos de IA e monitoramento em produção;
  • Definir arquitetura e fluxos de usuário utilizando ferramentas e agentes de IA como apoio à geração, testes e evolução de código;
  • Projetar arquiteturas escaláveis para uso intensivo de LLMs, com foco em performance, disponibilidade e experiência do usuário
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de CI/CD e MLOps para entrega contínua e segura de aplicações e modelos;
  • Garantir qualidade técnica por meio de revisões de código e aderência a boas práticas de engenharia e segurança da informação;
  • Ser referência técnica no time, contribuindo para a disseminação do desenvolvimento assistido por IA.
Competências técnicas
  • Sólida base em engenharia de software: algoritmos, design de sistemas e arquitetura full-stack independente de linguagem;
  • Experiência prática em desenvolvimento assistido por IA, com uso de ferramentas como Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou Replit;
  • Domínio de ecossistemas de IA: LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, LangChain ou Llama Index;
  • Experiência comAPIs escaláveis, microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos com containers (Docker) e orquestração;
  • Conhecimento embancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL;
  • Capacidade de implementar testes automatizados ao longo do ciclo de vida do software;
  • Comunicação clara e capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis.
Conhecimentos desejáveis
  • Experiência com gestão ágil de produtos, incluindo priorização de backlog e alinhamento técnico-negócio;
  • Fluência em inglês;
  • Conhecimento emética de IA, privacidade de dados (LGPD/GDPR) e mitigação de vieses em modelos.
Sobre a UPX

Há mais de 20 anos, a UPX protege ambientes digitais que não podem falhar. Somos uma empresa norte-americana de cibersegurança que já protegeu mais de 1.000 organizações nos setores financeiro, telecomunicações, cloud, mídia e streaming, jurídico e saúde e que confiam na UPX para manter suas operações no ar 24/7/365.

Nosso portfólio integra soluções em Serviços de Segurança Gerenciada AI-driven, Proteção de Borda, Proteção de Endpoints e Segurança de Agentes de IA.

Aqui você vai trabalhar com especialistas que operam em ambientes onde o erro tem consequências reais, onde problemas são complexos e o trabalho importa. Se você gosta de pensar no todo, não só na sua parte, você pensa como nós.

Acesse upx.Com para saber mais.

title: Data Scientist - Sênior (Motor De Busca)
description:

No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país. Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking. Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução da experiência de busca, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia e Negócio.Responsabilidades: Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional. Atuar na definição e otimização de: Estrutura de índices e mappings Estratégias de ranking híbrido (lexical + semântico) Queries semânticas (ex: embeddings, similarity search, boosting contextual) Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância. Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados. Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento. Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas.Requisitos necessários Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados. Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância. Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual). Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank. Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados. Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem. Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto. Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos. Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps. Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.Diferenciais Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes. Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery. Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca. Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling. Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.Perfil esperado Forte mentalidade de produto e experiência do usuário. Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto. Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta. Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados. Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares.#SeleçãoSBF #VempraSBF

title: Desenvolvedor Python Especialista - Ia Generativa
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Python Especialista - Ia Generativa em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa especialista em desenvolvimento backend com foco em Python para fortalecer plataformas e serviços críticos. A posição é estratégica e voltada à excelência técnica, com impacto direto em soluções que atendem milhões de clientes. Buscamos alguém com experiência sólida em microserviços, APIs escaláveis e aplicações robustas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Suas atividades:

  • Desenvolver serviços backend robustos, reutilizáveis e de alta performance com Python.
  • Projetar e evoluir arquiteturas de microserviços com foco em modularidade e escalabilidade.
  • Construir APIs RESTful com versionamento, autenticação e segurança.
  • Garantir qualidade e performance com práticas avançadas de testes e otimizações.
  • Automatizar processos de build, testes e publicação de bibliotecas internas.
  • Participar de revisões de código, definição de padrões e disseminação de boas práticas.
  • Investigar falhas e propor melhorias estruturais em produção.
  • Integrar sistemas legados e externos com boas práticas de interoperabilidade.
  • Colaborar com arquitetura, produto, QA e operações em soluções técnicas alinhadas ao negócio.

Perfil esperado:

  • Comunicação clara com perfis técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Tomada de decisão técnica com foco em simplicidade e sustentabilidade.
  • Capacidade de transformar requisitos de negócio em soluções viáveis.
  • Postura colaborativa e foco em entrega contínua.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Proficiência em Python com Django, Flask ou FastAPI.
  • Desenvolvimento backend end-to-end em arquitetura de microserviços.
  • Controle de versão (Git), build automation e gestão de dependências (pipenv, poetry).
  • Bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e uso de Redis.
  • Design e versionamento de APIs REST com Swagger/OpenAPI.
  • Testes automatizados (pytest, unittest) e TDD.
  • Princípios SOLID, injeção de dependência, modularidade e padrões de projeto (Factory, Strategy etc.).
  • Arquitetura cloud-agnostic com containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • CI/CD e versionamento semântico.
  • Otimização de performance em aplicações Python.

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em NoSQL, Elasticsearch e mecanismos de busca.
  • Clean Architecture, DDD, Hexagonal e 12-Factor App.
  • Scripts de automação (Bash/Shell) e empacotamento de bibliotecas internas.
  • Monitoramento e observabilidade (Grafana, CloudWatch, Splunk).
  • Vivência em ambientes multicloud e foco em otimização de custos.
  • Segurança de software (OWASP, OAuth 2.0, JWT) e governança técnica.
  • Uso de IA para produtividade (ex: GitHub Copilot).

title: Assistant Production Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Assistant Production Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Headshots.Com

At Headshots.Com, we're reimagining how professional headshots are created and delivered. Trusted by clients like Boeing, Capital One, and American Express, we transform smartphone selfies into polished, studio-quality portraits within three business days. Our work helps individuals and teams present themselves with consistency and confidence across digital platforms.

We're looking for an Assistant Production Manager, reporting to the Production Manager, who will co-lead our photo editing and quality control teams, guide strategy and drive operational excellence.

About the Role

This role combines production oversight with a deep appreciation for the artistry of headshot retouching. You'll manage the daily operations of our editing team, ensuring that each image reflects the clarity, subtlety, and professionalism our brand is known for.

We're seeking someone who brings both technical expertise and a discerning creative eye—someone who can guide a team to produce beautiful, natural edits that elevate the subject rather than over-process them.

Key Responsibilities

Production & Quality Control

  • Co-develop strategic initiatives to strengthen and improve production operations
  • Ensure timely reporting and clear communication across production workflows
  • Oversee daily editing operations to support consistent, high-quality delivery of headshots
  • Maintain quality standards across visual consistency, lighting, natural retouching, and overall image polish
  • Identify recurring issues, provide constructive feedback, and support continuous improvement across the production team
  • Step in as needed to assist with editing, troubleshooting, or complex production requests

Team Leadership & Coaching

  • Supervise and mentor a team of photo editors
  • Hire, train, and onboard new editors to uphold brand standards
  • Foster a collaborative, high-accountability culture with clear communication

Workflow Management & Operational Oversight

  • Monitor task queues and deadlines to ensure smooth project flow
  • Optimize systems and tools to eliminate inefficiencies or bottlenecks
  • Lead team meetings, track KPIs, and document standard operating procedures

Client & Project Coordination

  • Collaborate across internal teams to meet client-specific requirements
  • Maintain a client-centered approach while balancing quality and turnaround
  • Support the development of background templates, sample images, and visual assets as needed

What You Bring

Experience & Skills

  • 6+ years of photo retouching experience, especially in headshots or portraits
  • 3+ years managing creative or production teams
  • Experience with tools like Dropbox, Asana, and Slack
  • Strong organizational and communication skills

Mindset & Strengths

  • Excellent attention to detail and visual aesthetics
  • A\ "no-ego\" team player: You leave your ego at the door, take extreme ownership of your work, and build deep trust through transparent communication.
  • Reliable, deadline-driven, and calm under pressure
  • Creative problem-solver with a passion for helping people look their best
  • Comfortable giving and receiving feedback in a collaborative team environment

Why Join Us?

  • Flexible, remote work
  • Work with a high-performing creative team
  • Opportunity to shape the quality and scale of a fast-growing brand

Compensation: $16-18/hour (full-time contract) depending on experience

Schedule: Monday to Friday | Flexible hours (ET hours)

IMPORTANT:

Direct inquiries will disqualify candidates.

title: Senior Backend Typescript Engineer | Fully Remote | B2b
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Backend Typescript Engineer | Fully Remote | B2b em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Backend TypeScript Engineer to help build the core of its company intelligence platform. You will work on a fully serverless AWS backend in TypeScript, where clean architecture, readable code and long term maintainability matter more than clever engineering theatre. About Fullinfo Fullinfo is building a B2B company intelligence platform. The platform crawls more than 300 million active domains and turns messy web data into clean, structured and searchable company profiles. Sales and marketing teams use Fullinfo to find companies, contacts and insights that are normally hidden across websites, directories, registries and industry sources.The backend runs fully on AWS, written in TypeScript and built around serverless services like Lambda, S3, DynamoDB and SQS. The frontend is built in Angular. GraphQL is used where it makes sense.The team is small, international and senior. Around 11 people work across backend, frontend, UX UI, DevOps and machine learning. The culture is direct, calm and quality driven. title: Senior Automation Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Automation Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuação no suporte e sustentação da plataforma de automação de workloads, incluindo atendimento de tickets, troubleshooting e resolução de incidentes complexos.
  • Participação ativa no processo de migração da ferramenta Automation Engine (UC4) para o RunMyJobs, incluindo preparação de ambientes, suporte pós-migração e estabilização da aplicação.
  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de scripts e automações para suporte às operações do time.
  • Suporte à infraestrutura Windows e colaboração com equipes globais para resolução de problemas críticos.
  • Monitoramento e suporte a aplicações críticas, garantindo estabilidade, disponibilidade e melhoria contínua do ambiente.

Responsabilidades do cargo:

  • Atuar no suporte técnico e operacional de ferramentas de Job Scheduling e automação de workloads.
  • Realizar troubleshooting avançado, análise de causa raiz e resolução de incidentes em ambiente produtivo.
  • Apoiar a migração e estabilização da plataforma RunMyJobs, garantindo continuidade operacional.
  • Desenvolver scripts e automações utilizando linguagens de programação como Python e Java.
  • Executar atividades relacionadas à infraestrutura Windows e suporte a ambientes corporativos.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times globais, incluindo interação com equipes internacionais.
  • Participar de escalas de suporte On Call em finais de semana conforme necessidade do time.

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência com suporte técnico e troubleshooting de aplicações críticas.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de Job Scheduling, como Automation Engine/UC4, Control-M ou Autosys.
  • Experiência com suporte e desenvolvimento utilizando RunMyJobs será considerada um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais.
  • Conhecimento em Cloud Azure.
  • Experiência com programação/scripting utilizando Python e Java.
  • Conhecimentos em infraestrutura Windows.
  • Capacidade analítica e habilidade para resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Inglês avançado para suporte e interação com times globais.

title: Engenheiro Ia
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro Ia em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

Duties and Responsibilities:

- Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.

- Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.

- Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.

- Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.

- Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

- Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

- Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

- Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

- Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

- Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

- Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.

Minimum Education:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês Fluente
